job_description:
**Vacancy Name**

Senior Product Manager - AI

  

**Vacancy No**

VN1077

  

**Job Title**

Senior Product Manager - AI

  

**Work Location City**

Bangalore

  

**About Solifi**

Solifi deliver a solid financial technology foundation for equipment, working capital, wholesale, and automotive finance firms. At Solifi, we believe that commerce is only as strong as the system it runs on. Our mission is to reshape finance technology by bringing together proven solutions into a singular powerful technology platform designed to help protect and scale financial organizations. We guard our customers by being precise and reliable, we guide their success by combining powerful technology with proven expertise, and we help them grow by unleashing their potential.

  

**About the Team**

We are a small, high ownership AI team operating with the pace and ownership of a startup within a global enterprise. We build production grade AI products that are used by real customers, taking ideas from early experimentation and prototyping through evaluation, production deployment and continuous improvement. The team brings together AI product management, AI engineering and data expertise, with a strong emphasis on shipping, experimentation, quality and measurable customer outcomes. We work closely with product, engineering and domain teams across the business to identify where AI can create meaningful value and then build the systems required to deliver it reliably at scale. This is an opportunity to work on some of the core AI products shaping how modern AI is applied within enterprise software, while having significant influence over what we build, how we evaluate it and how AI products are built and operated in production.

  

**About the Position**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - AI to lead the development of production grade AI products that solve complex problems for enterprise customers.
  
  
This is a highly hands on product role for someone who understands that building AI products is fundamentally different from building traditional software. You will work at the intersection of product, data, AI, and domain expertise, with significant ownership over both the product outcome and the process used to prove that the AI system can reliably deliver it.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will not simply manage a backlog of AI features or translate requirements between customers and engineering. You will be expected to understand the problem, formulate the hypothesis, work with the data, determine how AI can solve it, establish how success will be measured, validate the solution and drive it all the way into production.
  
  
The goal is not to build AI for the sake of using AI. The goal is to build reliable, production-grade AI products that create measurable value for enterprise customers.

  

**Role and Responsibilities**

Identify high value customer problems, develop hypotheses around where AI can create measurable value and validate those hypotheses using data, experimentation and customer feedback.
  
  
Work hands on with large and complex datasets to understand the problem, identify patterns, test assumptions, and determine what is required to build an effective AI solution.
  
  
Partner with AI engineering and data teams to design AI powered product experiences, including grounding and retrieval systems, prompts, model selection, orchestration and AI workflows.
  
  
Build and own AI evaluation frameworks, including evaluation datasets, golden sets, test cases, metrics, automated evaluations, and human evaluation processes.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability for production systems and use evaluation and production data to identify failures, understand root causes and continuously improve the product.
  
  
Drive AI capabilities from prototype and proof of concept through production deployment, customer adoption and continuous improvement.
  
  
Define and measure the product and AI metrics that demonstrate whether the system is delivering the intended customer outcome.

  

**About You**

What We Are Looking For: • 7+ years of product management experience, with significant experience building and shipping B2B software products. • Strong hands-on experience building AI-powered products, where AI is a core part of the product experience and customer outcome. • Deep practical understanding of AI evaluation and experience building evaluation frameworks for AI products. • Strong experience with AI monitoring and observability, including identifying, diagnosing, and addressing failures in production AI systems. • Strong data skills and experience working with large-scale data. You should be comfortable understanding data structures, exploring datasets, analyzing data, and using data to validate product hypotheses and AI behavior. • Experience designing and building grounding systems and evaluation systems, rather than simply consuming AI APIs. • Experience with modern AI application architectures, including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, prompting, model selection, agents/workflows, and orchestration. • Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous problem, formulate hypotheses, validate them with data and experimentation, and turn the resulting insight into a production product. • Experience building products for B2B customers in heavily regulated industries, such as financial services, fintech, insurance, healthcare, or similar domains. • Strong understanding of enterprise AI considerations including accuracy, reliability, explainability, security, governance, data quality, and auditability. • Ability to work deeply with technical teams and engage in detailed discussions about AI system behavior without needing to be the engineer implementing the system. • Familiarity with the AWS ecosystem is preferred. • Strong product judgment and the ability to distinguish between an impressive AI demo and an AI system that is genuinely reliable enough for production use. What Will Set You Apart: • You have taken an AI product from hypothesis prototype evaluation production continuous monitoring and improvement. • You have personally designed or owned an AI evaluation framework and understand why evaluation is central to building reliable AI products. • You have worked through difficult AI failure modes and know how to investigate whether a problem originates in the model, data, retrieval, grounding, prompting, orchestration, or product workflow. • You have experience building AI products where incorrect outputs have meaningful business or customer consequences. • You are comfortable challenging an initial hypothesis when the data or evaluations do not support it. • You naturally think in terms of measurable customer outcomes rather than AI features. • You enjoy getting into the details and are equally comfortable discussing a customer workflow, analyzing an evaluation dataset, investigating AI output failures, and working with engineers on the product architecture.

  

**Preferred Experience Level**

7 years

  

**Preferred Education Level**

Master's Degree

  

**Employment Basis**

Full Time

  

**Benefits**

Group Medical Insurance, Group Personal Accident, Employee Anniversary gift, Loyalty Bonus, Employee Referral Bonus, Rewards and Recognition program, Wellness Allowance, Privilege Leave (PL): 15 days per year, Casual Leave (CL) 12 days per year, Maternity/paternity/Bereavement leave

  

**Applications Close Date**

07 Apr 2027

**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

  
  
**Job Description**

* Define product requirements, work with engineering teams, and deliver solutions that meet user needs. Scope includes driving transformational growth across our Sports Research and Consulting products and solutions, as well as our Video Games Tracking research.
* Requires at least ten years of specialized depth and breadth of expertise relating to **multi-country quantitative research,** including questionnaire and code frame design, research process automation using AI, advanced analytical modelling and visualization of complex analytical outcomes from these data types. Also requires a strong proven understanding of marketing science as it applies to brand equity, sales forecasting, use of imputation and synthetic data, and a rigorous grounding in research statistics.

The following will give a candidate a strong advantage in applying for this role:

* Client facing experience with blue chip brand marketing teams and the insights teams that support them.
* Practical experience of large scale agentic AI applications in quantitative multi-country tracking survey research.

* Interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices
* Solves complex problems; Takes a broad perspective to identify innovative solutions
* Works independently, with guidance in only the most complex situations
* May lead functional teams or projects

Responsibilities

Recognized for deep expertise in a specific discipline or function, solving complex problems and guiding project teams or functional processes.

 **Qualifications**

Qualifications

* Interprets internal/external business challenges and recommends best practices to improve products, processes or services
* Leads others to solve complex problems; uses analytical thinking, tools and judgement to identify innovative solutions
* May lead teams or projects with moderate resource requirements, risk, and/or complexity
* Communicates complex concepts; anticipates potential objections and influences others to adopt a different point of view
* Requires depth and/or breadth of expertise in own specialized area and general knowledge of related areas
* Impacts the achievement of customer, operational, project or service objectives; work is guided by department objectives
* 10-15 years, recognized expertise in a specific area.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; advanced degree or specialized certifications strongly preferred.

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. **About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Product Manager

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead complex initiatives including establishing marketing programs for new products or enhancements
* Conduct market research and market results-oriented analysis for major products and services
* Review and analyze complex major product lines and services
* Implement change delivery solutions for the portfolio's technology process work of low to moderate complexity
* Make decisions in complex and multi-faceted situations of global market dynamics, trends, and regulatory impact
* Oversee risk management to meet deliverables and drive new initiatives
* Collaborate and consult with managers, stakeholders, scrum masters, project managers, and delivery team to resolve issues and achieve project goals
* Lead projects, teams, or serve as a mentor to less experienced staff

**Required Qualifications:**

* **5+** years of Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or equivalent experience.
* Lead one or more product teams in delivering business and customer value through execution of product initiatives aligned with established product strategies and roadmaps.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities, customer needs, risk requirements, and regulatory commitments.
* Collaborate with L2/L3 Product Managers and stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into actionable epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Drive backlog refinement, sprint planning, release planning, product reviews, and demonstrations to ensure effective execution and delivery.
* Partner with technology, architecture, operations, and business teams to define solutions and ensure successful implementation of product enhancements and capabilities.
* Facilitate prioritization decisions across competing demands while balancing customer value, operational efficiency, technical dependencies, and regulatory requirements.
* Manage cross-functional dependencies, identify delivery risks, remove impediments, and drive timely resolution of issues impacting product delivery.
* Validate business requirements and acceptance criteria to ensure delivered solutions meet customer expectations, quality standards, and business objectives.
* Monitor product area performance, user adoption, operational outcomes, and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Support process automation, AI-enabled capabilities, and modernization initiatives that enhance customer experience and operational effectiveness.
* Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Control partners to ensure solutions adhere to enterprise policies, governance frameworks, and regulatory requirements.
* Communicate product priorities, delivery progress, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Drive a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and Agile best practices across the product team.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior Product Owners and team members while promoting effective product management practices.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* CSPO/PSPO Certified
* Experience in Commercial Banking, Supply Chain Finance, Lending, Receivables Finance, Treasury Management, Payments, or related banking domains.
* Experience supporting platform modernization, workflow automation, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Knowledge of banking regulatory, risk, and control frameworks.
* Experience with SQL, Power BI, data analytics, and reporting tools.
* Familiarity with AI, Generative AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven product decision making.
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and modern product operating models.

**Posting End Date:**

28 Oct 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

**Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:**

a. Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.

b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
Candidates for this position are preferred to be based in Bangalore, India and will be expected to comply with their team’s hybrid work schedule requirements.
  
  
Senior Manager, Product Management
  
  
**Team:** Customer Technology
  
**Location:** Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
At Wayfair, we're working to make shopping more personal, relevant, and easier for millions of customers.
  
  
The Customer Understanding team builds the intelligence that helps Wayfair better understand what customers like, what they're looking for, and how their needs change over time. We turn customer behavior and signals into shared capabilities that power better search, recommendations, personalization, and shopping experiences.
  
  
This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of Product, AI/ML, and customer experience, solving problems at scale and shaping how Wayfair understands and serves its customers.
  
  
Learn more about our technology teams on the[1] Wayfair Tech Blog.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
**Think big and work backwards from the customer:** Imagine what a great shopping experience could look like, identify gaps in how we understand customers, and define what we need to build.
  
  
**Shape strategy, not just a roadmap:** Challenge assumptions, solve ambiguous problems, and build a clear point of view on where to invest and why.
  
  
**Work at the cutting edge of AI/ML and data:** Partner with ML, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Platform teams to build scalable products, balancing model quality, performance, reliability, and cost.
  
  
**Connect technology to customer impact:** Work with Search, Recommendations, and other teams to turn customer intelligence into better shopping experiences, and validate the impact with experiments.
  
  
**See the bigger picture:** Connect opportunities across teams, customer journeys, and businesses. Bring fresh thinking from industry trends and advances in AI.
  
  
**Navigate complexity and drive progress:** Work across distributed teams with different priorities, build alignment, make trade-offs, and move things forward without waiting for perfect clarity.
  
  
**Own outcomes, not just delivery:** Take products from discovery to launch and adoption, measure real impact, and adapt based on what you learn.
  
  
What We're Looking For
  
  
9+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex products and delivering measurable customer or business impact.
  
  
Strong product thinking, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems, identify opportunities, and build a clear strategy.
  
  
Experience working with Engineering, Data Science, or ML teams on data-driven, platform, or algorithmic products.
  
  
Strong analytical skills and experience using customer insights, data, and experimentation to guide decisions.
  
  
Ability to understand technical concepts and trade-offs, while staying focused on customer problems and business outcomes.
  
  
Strong communication and collaboration skills, especially when working across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  
  
It's a Plus If You Have
  
  
Experience in e-commerce, personalization, search, recommendations, or customer data products.
  
  
Familiarity with customer embeddings, intent modeling, recommender systems, or cold-start personalization.
  
  
Experience building ML-powered products or reusable data and intelligence platforms.
  
  
References
  
  
Visible links
  
1. https://www.aboutwayfair.com/careers/tech-blog

title: Group Product Manager, Physical AI & Robotics
job_description:
**Who We Are**
--------------

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across various service offerings: Web, Mobile & Digital Marketing | Enterprise AI | Customer Care AI & Technology | Enterprise Technology Modernization

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

**Location & Flexibility**
--------------------------

**India Hybrid: Bengaluru**
---------------------------

This is a hybrid role. This model requires the ability to work in a hybrid mode from our office in Bengaluru(2 to 3 times/ week). Our office culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members, local and visiting, from other global offices.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Robotics foundation models need millions of hours of dense, real-world data—and simulation alone won't cut it. TELUS Digital is solving the Physical AI bottleneck, capturing highly calibrated, real-world data at scale across hundreds of devices to power the world's leading hyperscalers.

We are hiring a **Group Product Manager** for the **Physical AI Robotics product team**. You will own the tooling this runs on: capture applications, operator workflows, session management, review and QA, and customer delivery. You will work with the researchers consuming the data and the operators producing it, and the standards you set will carry into how the industry does this.

Your application will stand out if you are demonstrably curious and have side work projects to showcase.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* 8-12 years in product management, including at least 2 in robotics, physical AI, AR/VR, autonomous systems, or data collection at scale.
* Own the roadmap for robotics data collection, setting direction and driving execution across engineering, design, operations, quality, and solutions.
* Assess demand for new capture modalities, then define the collection model, hardware, and tooling.
* Work with engineering and design on the operator experience: onboarding, task guidance, in-session feedback, error states, review workflows. Operators work one-handed, in motion, wearing a headset, or against a clock.
* Build prototypes and write the specs. Requirements and user stories that hold up under engineering review.
* Translate customer model requirements into collection designs, and evolving research into quality standards for egocentric data: pose accuracy, sync tolerance, occlusion handling, annotation schema, acceptance criteria.
* Spend time with collectors, session leads, and reviewers. When data underperforms in training, trace it back to the capture design or the tooling that produced it.
* Represent the product directly to hyperscaler and robotics foundation model teams, and bring their constraints back into the roadmap.
* Optimize for yield per session, rejection rate, cost per usable hour, capture-to-delivery time, and operator retention.
* Champion pilots as the default way to test a change. Small cohort, clear hypothesis, fixed window. Scale what works and stop what does not.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems) or equivalent experience..
* Technical depth to hold a real conversation with a research team.
* Direct experience with one or more of: egocentric or wearable data capture, teleoperation systems, robot data pipelines, multi-sensor collection rigs or similar setups
* Experience defining product vision and roadmaps in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

* Hands-on robotics background. Robotics, ML engineer on embodied models, teleoperation engineer, or similar.
* Familiarity with imitation learning, VLA models, or manipulation policy training, and the data those methods need.
* Experience managing distributed human operations, including crowd or contractor workforces.
* You have shipped something physical and understand calibration, sensor sync, and coordinate frames, and how they fail.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

*At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.*

We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us.

For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.

title: Sr. Product Manager I
job_description:
We are looking to hire a Senior Product Manager I to own the integrations and agentic ecosystem for Brandfolder, Smartsheet's Digital Asset Management platform. This is a high-growth, strategically critical product area. It covers how Brandfolder connects to the tools where marketing and creative teams work, and how AI agents find, use and govern brand content through MCP, connectors, APIs and partner integrations.

Your work will determine whether Brandfolder is the trusted source of brand content for people and AI agents alike. This is an individual contributor role for a product leader with strong technical fluency, deep customer instincts and the confidence to drive a complex, cross-surface product area across multiple engineering teams and external partners.

**You Will**
------------

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for Brandfolder's MCP server, connector framework, public API and integrations and make clear prioritization and sequencing decisions
* Define how AI agents such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Copilot discover, retrieve, create and update brand assets, while keeping permissions, usage rights and brand governance intact
* Lead the evolution of Brandfolder's integration portfolio
* Define the API and agent-readiness strategy: authentication, scopes, rate limits, webhooks, tool design and developer experience for customers, partners and AI clients
* Own the quality, reliability and supportability of existing integrations, and shape the migration path from legacy connectors to the new platform
* Lead customer and partner discovery sessions to validate assumptions
* Author crisp product briefs, requirements and technical specs that design and engineering can execute without ambiguity, from discovery through GA and post-launch
* Drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, design, security, GTM, Customer Success, Support and partner teams
* Define success metrics for every feature, such as integration adoption, active accounts, agent task success, API usage and work with data teams to ensure instrumentation from day one
* Represent product in leadership reviews, MBRs, partner conversations and customer engagements
* Contribute to packaging and pricing decisions for integrations and AI capabilities

**You Have**
------------

* 4+ years of product management experience delivering high-impact features in enterprise SaaS or B2B software
* Experience owning platform, API, integration, connectors or developer-facing product areas, including how products work with AI models and agents is a strong plus
* Experience with content, digital asset management, marketing technology or workflow products is a plus
* Proven ability to navigate ambiguous, technically complex problem spaces and make clear scoping and sequencing decisions across multiple engineering teams and external partners
* A working understanding of authentication and authorization (OAuth, SSO, role-based permissions), APIs and webhooks, and data security considerations for AI
* Strong customer instincts: you run structured discovery, synthesize signal and turn it into well-scoped, validated decisions
* A track record of excellent product briefs, requirements and specs that engineering acts on without ambiguity
* Demonstrated ability to drive alignment across engineering, design, security, GTM and Customer Success, including third-party partner dependencies
* A data-driven mindset: you define adoption, funnel, quality and reliability metrics before you ship and use post-launch data to guide iteration
* Excellent written and verbal communication

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager-I
job_description:
**About MoEngage:**

MoEngage is an insights-led customer engagement platform trusted by 1,350+ global consumer brands, including McAfee, Flipkart, Domino’s, Nestle, Deutsche Telekom, and OYO. MoEngage combines data from multiple sources to help brands gain a 360-degree view of their customers.

MoEngage Analytics arms marketers and product owners with insights into customer behavior. Brands can leverage MoEngage Personalize to orchestrate journeys and build 1:1 conversations across the website, mobile, email, social, and messaging channels. MoEngage Inform, the transactional messaging infrastructure, helps unify promotional and transactional communication to a single platform for better insights and lower costs. MoEngage’s AI Suite helps marketers develop winning copies and creatives, optimize campaigns and channels that boost engagement, and help with faster execution.

For over a decade, consumer brands in 60+ countries have been using MoEngage to power digital experiences for over a billion monthly customers. With offices in 15 countries, MoEngage is backed by Goldman Sachs Asset Management, B Capital, Steadview Capital, Multiples Private Equity, Eight Roads, F-Prime Capital, Matrix Partners, Ventureast, and Helion Ventures.

MoEngage was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Real-Time Interaction Management, Q1 2024 report, and Strong Performer in The Forrester Wave™ 2023 report. MoEngage was also featured as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Omni-Channel Marketing Platforms for B2C Enterprises 2023.

**About the Role**  
Messaging is where marketing actually meets the customer — the push that gets opened, the WhatsApp that gets replied to, the SMS that drives the click. You'll own a slice of the Campaigns product — the engine behind messaging across Push, Email, SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, and In-App channels — and be judged on whether customers actually adopt what you ship, not on how well you followed the spec someone else wrote.  
You're a few years into your PM career, not new to it. You've shipped things end-to-end, learned what "done" actually means in practice, and know the difference between a feature customers use every day and a feature that only exists in a release note.  
You'll report into the Campaigns product team, work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and design, and spend a meaningful chunk of your week talking to customers, reading support threads, and digging through usage data — because that's where the real opportunities live, not in a brainstorm.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* **Customer Research, Relentlessly-** Run structured VoC/VoP analysis — customer calls, support ticket audits, CSM conversations, in-app feedback — to build a constantly-updated picture of where Campaigns is winning and where it's losing deals or trust. Turn scattered anecdotes into a ranked list of real problems.
* **Opportunity Mining-** Don't wait for a PRD to land in your inbox. Mine support channels, churn signals, and feature requests to surface the 2-3 gaps that matter most this quarter — and defend why those and not the other twenty.
* **Execution, End to End-** From decision-anchored PRD to shipped feature — write the spec, resolve edge cases, sit in every standup that matters, unblock engineering, and make trade-off calls when scope and timeline collide. Ideas are cheap; shipped is the job.
* **Adoption Is the Metric-** Shipping isn't done at code-complete. Partner with CS, Sales, and Marketing to drive activation — enablement decks, in-app nudges, customer outreach — and own the adoption number, not just the release note.
* **Voice of the Customer, Internally-** Be the translator between "what customers are saying" and "what we build next." Feed structured research back into prioritization debates and hold the team accountable to solving the problem, not just the ticket.

**What we're looking for**

* 3+ years of product management experience in a B2B SaaS environment.
* Evidence you've owned something end-to-end — from problem discovery to shipped, adopted feature — not just been on the team that did.
* Sharp customer instincts, and the willingness to keep earning them by talking to actual users every single week.
* A clear thinker and clearer writer; you can turn a messy problem into a one-pager that gets a decision made.

**Bonus points**

* Experience in Martech / Customer Engagement / Marketing Automation.
* Familiarity with messaging channels (SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Push) as a builder or a heavy operator.
* Comfort with API-driven or platform products, and the ambiguity that comes with them.

At MoEngage, we respect and value differences. We believe that when people from diverse backgrounds and perspectives collaborate, we create the most value – for our clients, our employees, and society. We embrace diversity and uphold a strong set of values. We are committed to inclusivity and take pride in providing equal opportunities for success and growth.

Employment at MoEngage is based solely on professional competence, skills, and experience. We stand firmly against all forms of discrimination and support equal rights and opportunities regardless of gender, ethnicity, abilities, age, identity, orientation or expression, marital status (including pregnancy), religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by law.

It is our policy to comply with all applicable national, state, and local laws related to non-discrimination and equal opportunity. MoEngage is truly a place where everyone can bring their passions, authentic selves, and talents to work, collaborating to drive progress and solve meaningful challenges.

  

**Why Join Us!**

At MoEngage, we are passionate about our team and technology - see below to know more about us.

Life@MoEngage

Tech@MoEngage

Scale @MoEngage

We handle more than a billion messages every day. Rest assured, you will be surrounded by really smart and passionate people as we scale much more to build a world-class technology team.

title: Technical Product Manager
job_description:
We are looking for a **Technical Product Manager** to join our Technology team in India.

In this hands-on role, you will shape the technical direction of our products and SaaS offerings, working closely with functional product owners to lead architecture, design, delivery, deployment, and ongoing support. You will combine strong product ownership with hands-on technical expertise to build scalable enterprise solutions and drive AI-enabled product development.

### **How You’ll Make an Impact -**

* Define and deliver the technology strategy for products and solutions in partnership with functional product owners.
* Own the technical platform and landscape across the full product lifecycle, including deployment, hosting, licensing, SLAs, post-sales support, and continuous enhancement.
* Introduce **AI-first tools, practices, and standards** to translate user stories into actionable sprints and delivery plans.
* Act as the technical product owner and primary technical contact across multiple products and solutions.
* Lead and coordinate a small team of **AI-enabled developers** while remaining actively involved in development.
* Establish effective **QA, DevOps, CI/CD, and engineering practices** across the product portfolio.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and apply relevant innovations to keep products scalable, secure, and competitive.

### **Your Expertise -**

* **7–10 years of digital product experience**, including at least 2 years building digital products and working as a technical product owner.
* Hands-on experience using **agentic AI** for solution design, software development, and unit testing.
* Experience building at least one **product, add-on, accelerator, or framework extending a standard SAP solution**.
* Experience using **SAP BTP/BAIP or another hyperscaler platform** to build and host digital products supporting mission-critical processes.
* Strong delivery experience in at least **two** of the following technology areas:
  + ABAP and OData
  + SAPUI5, Fiori, React, or comparable UX frameworks
  + RAP, CAP, Java, or Node.js
  + SAP HANA Cloud or PostgreSQL
* Strong understanding of **multi-tenant SaaS and on-stack add-on architectures**.
* Solid knowledge of **information security and cybersecurity principles**.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.

### **Nice to Have**

* Previous experience with an enterprise software/product organization.
* Domain knowledge across **SAP ERP, SAP EWM, and/or SAP TM**.
* Understanding of **SAP S/4HANA architecture, indirect licensing, and API access policies**.
* Experience with the **SAP PartnerEdge Build** model.

### **Why Join Westernacher**

* Inspiring, innovative, and entrepreneurial working environment.
* Competitive remuneration package including salary, bonus, and benefits.
* International company culture with minimal hierarchical structure.
* Opportunity to shape and build enterprise products and SaaS solutions with real customer impact.
* Exposure to global teams, technologies, and delivery models.
* Opportunity to drive **AI-first product development** and influence the future technical direction of our solutions.

**This is Westernacher -**

Founded in 1969, Westernacher Consulting is a global business and SAP consulting company represented in 28 countries, with 1,400 consultants across Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Americas. As an SAP Gold Partner with over 30 years of experience as an SAP partner, we combine deep industry knowledge, business process expertise and technology innovation to create sustainable value for our clients.

We are 100% employee-owned, which shapes our entrepreneurial culture and our commitment to shared responsibility, long-term thinking and sustainable success. We work in partnership, challenge conventional thinking and give our people the opportunity to create meaningful impact for our clients, our company and one another.

Westernacher is committed to equal opportunity and an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and make employment decisions based on qualifications, experience and business needs, in accordance with applicable local law.

Life@Westernacher

#LI-TW1

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

### **Job Title**

Global Product Manager- Accelerators

### **Job Description**

**Global Product Manager- Accelerators** will **lead the incubation of early-stage products and technologies,** including internally developed and partnered solutions; **translate emerging concepts into scalable new-product opportunities**

**Your Role**

* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, including portfolio strategy, roadmap development, value propositions, and business case execution.
* Lead new product development and PDLM governance, ensuring timely, profitable, and compliant product launches.
* Develop portfolio positioning, claims strategies, and customer segmentation based on market insights, competitive analysis, and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with R&D, Innovation, Sales, Marketing, Manufacturing, and regional teams to deliver commercially successful solutions.
* Build and manage KOL relationships to strengthen product credibility, thought leadership, and market adoption.
* Drive global launch readiness and support regional go-to-market execution.
* Provide strategic guidance and product expertise to regional marketing and sales teams to accelerate growth and market penetration.
* Ensure achievement of commercial objectives, portfolio profitability, and Annual Operating Plan (AOP) targets.
Oversee product validation and testing activities to ensure quality, performance, and customer satisfaction.  

**You're the right fit if:**

* You’ve acquired **10+ years of experience** in an international business environment in the field of product management, marketing, or related commercial/strategic role in medical devices or health technology. Exposure to **Regulatory frameworks** (FDA, EU MDR) and Reimbursement considerations

* You have a **Bachelor's/ master’s degree** in business administration, Marketing, Engineering, Product Management or equivalent.

* You have **Startup, innovation, digital health, software product management, or venture-building experience** ; software experience strongly preferred; comfortable operating with ambiguity and early-stage R&D
* You have **strong stakeholder management, communication, and facilitation skills** , enabling you to effectively lead cross-functional collaboration and influence decision-making.

**How we work together**

We believe that we are better together than apart. This role is part of our **office‑based team** , requiring in‑person collaboration **at least three days per week** in office.

**About Philips**  
We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Digital Product Manager
job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Product backlog and prioritization of user stories with team members
* Manage Capital fund and work directly with Finance to ensure we our budget is in line
* Establish success metrics, OKRs (Objective and Key Results), and go-to-market plan and help lead
* Product owners in meeting their Business Objectives
* Be the voice of the customer and end-user; proactively provide customer feedback to internal teams. This includes being the voice of the service organization that is closest to the customer.
* Practical understanding of Scrum principles and practices
* Partners with Scrum master's in supporting Scrum Framework
* Shares and decomposes Features into user stories (non-technical)
* Develop a deep understanding of the customer and product needs
* Recognized voice of the business to the team
* Test, validate and identify weaknesses in prototypes and make the necessary changes (A/B, research, analysis, usability, etc.)
* Build, manage and develop a team of business analysts/testers.
* Ensures traceability between requirements to Features to user stories
* Review of test cases against user stories acceptance criteria
* Periodically re-prioritize the Product Backlog based on customer feedback, market changes and business priority as communicated by the Product Manager
* Formally accepts the user stories once all acceptance criteria are met
* Actively participates in Product Backlog grooming sessions, retrospectives, defect management and project team's release planning sessions
* Accessible for the team to answer questions, and during Sprint planning sessions, and Daily Scrum
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements.

**What you will need to be successful:**

* **Vision**: Always looking through the lens of the consumer and thinking of how to make their life better
* A solid understanding of User Experience: Experience in product management, product development, and User Experience design
* **Ability to ask Why:** Comfortable asking the right questions to quickly understand the core of the user needs
* **Instinct**: Solid consumer product instincts
* **Dig Deep:** Being able to dig in and go all the way down the rabbit hole to identify those unique opportunities
* **Collaboration**: Experience incubating and commercializing new ideas by working closely with technical and creative teams. Ability to navigate and lead through a complex matrix organization to deliver outcomes
* **Communication**: Ability to present and hold a dialog in a variety of forums: executive, front-line and industry events
* Influence without authority: Provide guidance and information to business for prioritizing high value work

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or 5+ years of additional relevant experience
* 5+ years of experience with Product Owner, Project Management and / or Business Analysis
* 5+ years of experience working in a contact Center/Call Center Environment
* 3+ years working with Finance managing budgets and financial goals
* Experience driving teams and management to decisions
* Experience working with cross functional teams
* Experience systematically analyzing problems, drawing relevant conclusions, and devising appropriate courses of action

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in working with Agile / Scrum work environment as a Product Owner: writing user stories, and following the development process through user story acceptance
* Experience working with IVR or call technology systems
* Healthcare insurance industry experience
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio and Outlook
* Demonstrated ability to effectively break down barriers to maintain progress on initiatives
* Demonstrated ability to make quick decisions when clarification or modification is needed
* Proven diplomatic with solid negotiation and conflict resolution skills
* Proven adept at adjusting to changing circumstances quickly and professionally
* Proven excellent oral, written and interpersonal communication with both technical and business audiences
* Demonstrated strategic thinking by using appropriate information to diagnose problems, identify possible solutions and collaborate with impacted groups to drive decisions
* Proven self-directed and able to drive detailed solutions to completion with minimal oversight
* Proven detail oriented and obsessively organized

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

author: Hiring Manager
title: Technical Product Manager
job_description:
### **About ArmorCode**

ArmorCode delivers the Agentic Control Plane for Unified Exposure Management. The ArmorCode platform ingests findings from 400+ security tools, correlates them with business context in the Context Risk Graph, and puts Anya AI agents to work prioritizing, routing, and verifying fixes. Enterprises including Visa, PayPal, Volvo Group, and Johnson Controls use ArmorCode to remediate at machine speed and reduce risk fast.

Processing over 400 billion findings a year across hundreds of native integrations, ArmorCode unifies, prioritizes, and drives remediation across applications, cloud, code, infrastructure, and AI. Powered by Anya, the industry's first agentic AI framework for enterprise security, ArmorCode is trusted by global enterprises to reduce exposure and adopt AI and modern software practices with confidence, without replacing existing tools or forcing vendor consolidation.

ArmorCoders believe in five core values: **Hungry. Humble. Hardworking. Honest. Human.** Our organization is powered by exceptional professionals who bring fresh ideas and passion to their roles, believing that nothing is beyond reach when our "5H" principles are applied. In their work and professional relationships, ArmorCoders commit to excellence and experiences that leave an impression.

  

### **About the Role**

As Technical Product Manager, you’ll own the definition, development, and maintenance of key product areas focused on unified exposure management capabilities of the platform. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally (Engineering, Data, UX, Customer Success, Sales) and take accountability for product-market fit, prioritization, launch, and adoption.

This is a high-impact role: you will shape what our platform surfaces and how our customers consume insights to drive their business outcomes.

  

### **What You'll Own**

* Serve as the voice of the customer: deeply understand how enterprise security teams operate their Application Security and Vulnerability management workflows to make decisions, and drive product design accordingly.
* Define product requirements, user stories, mock-ups, and acceptance criteria, and work with UX/Engineering/Data to deliver.
* Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to craft messaging, training, collateral, and go-to-market strategies.
* Interact and collaborate with Support, Customer Success, and field teams to understand customer issues and drive business outcomes
* Monitor usage, adoption, customer feedback, and business metrics — drive continuous improvement and optimization.
* Work with customers and internal teams across geographies to close gaps and open questions in order to drive execution
* Understand market landscape, competitive offerings, and identify opportunities for differentiation and disruption.

  

### **Who you are**

* 3+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS companies
* Solid experience with B2B SaaS analytics platforms—enough to jump into the security space.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with data/engineering to build scalable analytical solutions and visualization layers.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, prioritisation skills, and ability to work across teams.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in business, engineering, computer science, or related field.

  

### **Why You Will Love It**

* Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in promoting from within and provide career progression paths, enabling our employees to advance in their careers
* Work-Life Balance: We understand the importance of a healthy work-life balance, offering flexible hours and remote work options to promote a sustainable lifestyle
* Collaborative Environment: Our company fosters a collaborative and inclusive workplace culture, where employees can collaborate and learn from each other's experiences
* Employee Recognition: We value and recognize the contributions of our team members through awards, employee of the month programs, and other forms of acknowledgment.
* Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries and performance-based bonuses, recognizing and rewarding the hard work and dedication of our team
* Comprehensive Benefits: Our benefits package includes health insurance for employees and dependents, to support the overall well-being of our employees. We encourage learning and skilling, and aid our employees to continuously upskill themselves.
* Diversity and Inclusion: We are committed to diversity and inclusion, striving to create an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered

Join ArmorCode and lead the charge in reducing signal fatigue, prioritizing risk and streamlining key cybersecurity workflows. Apply today to be part of a close-knit team, dedicated to democratizing software security and helping build the safest software possible.

### **Equal Opportunity**

ArmorCode is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or any other legally protected category. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment regardless of their background or characteristics. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with respect and dignity.

title: Technical Product Manager
job_description:
**ABOUT THE PRODUCT MANAGER ROLE:**

WIN is looking for Technical Product Managers to join our growing team in India. You will work at the intersection of AI, operations, data, and customer experience to build scalable, high-impact products across internal and customer-facing platforms. This is not a Scrum Master or delivery coordination role. This role requires a strong product mindset - someone who can identify opportunities before the market does, translate ambiguity into structured systems, and build products that fundamentally change how people work. You will work across AI-powered workflows, inspection operations, data intelligence, and platform thinking to create products that drive real business outcomes and long-term value.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

* Define and drive product strategy for internal and customer-facing platforms
* Identify product opportunities across AI, automation, analytics, and workflow optimization
* Translate complex and ambiguous business problems into structured product solutions
* Collaborate with engineering, design, operations, and leadership to shape product roadmap
* Build scalable product systems and frameworks instead of one-off feature solutions
* Prioritize initiatives based on impact, adoption, and business outcomes
* Leverage data, user research, and experimentation to deeply understand user behaviour
* Drive execution with clarity and ownership without acting as a project coordinator
* Focus on long-term product value including adoption, retention, efficiency, and ecosystem growth

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**  

* 6+ years of experience in Product Management or Product Ownership in a product-driven company
* Strong understanding of APIs, system integrations, and platform architecture fundamentals
* Familiarity with AI/LLM workflows and their practical applications in products
* Experience with product analytics, experimentation, and data-driven decision making
* Understanding of SaaS product models and workflow automation ecosystems
* Ability to work closely with engineering teams and evaluate technical feasibility
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to simplify complex systems
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Experience working in cross-functional teams in an agile environment
* Ownership mindset, curiosity, and bias for action

**GOOD TO HAVE:**  

* Experience with AI copilots, conversational interfaces, or workflow engines
* Exposure to automation tools, predictive analytics, or operational products
* Experience building or scaling B2B SaaS platforms
* Strong understanding of product-led growth principles
* Design AI-first product experiences rather than simply adding AI features

  

**WHY JOIN US?**  

* High-energy team enthusiastic about disrupting a massive industry
* Highly inclusive and collaborative culture built on mutual respect
* Focus on core values, initiative, leadership, and adaptability
* Strong emphasis on personal and professional development
* Opportunity to build AI-first products that create real business leverage
* Flexibility to work remotely

  

**WHAT WE OFFER:**

* Highly inclusive and collaborative culture
* Opportunity to work closely with India-based and US-based teams
* Strong focus on learning, ownership, and growth
* 100% remote working flexibility

  

**ABOUT WIN & OUR CULTURE:**

WIN is the #1 ranked inspection services company in the United States. Backed by 35 years of excellence, we are on a mission to build a global brand through cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven innovation, and operational excellence. WIN has the stability of an established leader as well as the energy of a fast-growing organization. We offer like-minded professionals a unique opportunity for meaningful personal and professional growth.

title: Senior Product Manager (POS, Retail)
job_description:
Roles & Responsibilities

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager – POS to own the strategy, roadmap, customer

experience, and business outcomes for Ginesys’s POS portfolio across Cloud POS, Offline

POS, Mobile POS, and omnichannel store journeys. You will combine deep retail and POS

expertise with strong product craft to modernise a mission-critical store platform and shape

the future of intelligent store commerce.

Key Responsibilities

1. POS Product Strategy, Market & Discovery

● Own the long-term product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Cloud, Offline, Mobile,

and Omnichannel POS within Ginesys One.

● Build deep understanding of retailers, store associates, market shifts, and global

POS competition to identify whitespace and differentiated product bets.

● Prioritise roadmap investments using customer value, market opportunity,

competitive advantage, revenue potential, and ROI; distinguish scalable needs from

one-off customisation.

● Shape the modernisation and migration strategy for existing POS capabilities while

protecting continuity for enterprise retailers.

2. Modern Store & Omnichannel Experience

● Reimagine core store journeys across billing, payments, promotions, loyalty, returns,

inventory visibility, assisted selling, and endless aisle.

● Design seamless experiences across stores, e-commerce, marketplaces, and

customer channels, including Mobile POS and checkout-anywhere experiences.

● Own product quality across speed, usability, reliability, offline resilience, multi-device

environments, and high-volume enterprise store networks.

3. Platform, Architecture & Product Execution

● Partner deeply with Engineering and Architecture on APIs, data flows, sync, security,

performance, observability, extensibility, and backward compatibility.

● Ensure seamless integration with ERP, OMS, WMS, CRM, loyalty, payments, tax,

e-commerce, and third- party retail ecosystems.

● Translate strategy into crisp requirements, prototypes, workflows, and measurable

release outcomes; make sound trade-offs between speed, technical foundations, and

long-term platform leverage.

● Lead cross-functional execution with Design, Engineering, QA, Customer Success,

and Implementation from discovery through launch and adoption.

4. AI-First Store Innovation

● Identify meaningful AI-native opportunities across checkout, associate assistance,

store operations, recommendations, automation, fraud/risk, and customer

experience.

● Use contemporary AI and rapid prototyping tools hands-on to validate concepts

faster and explore intelligent assistance, natural-language interfaces, and agentic

store workflows.

● Challenge legacy retail workflows and help define what an intelligent, connected

store experience should look like for the next decade.

5. Business Outcomes, Adoption & Monetisation

● Own measurable outcomes across adoption, usage depth, customer satisfaction,

retention, revenue influence, and expansion.

● Define success metrics before launch, track post-launch performance, and use data

and customer feedback to drive continuous improvement.

● Partner with Sales and Marketing on positioning, packaging, competitive

differentiation, and monetisation; equip Customer Success and Support to drive

adoption and customer value.

Pay: ₹2,730,000.00 - ₹4,500,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Must have a minimum of 8 years of experience in product management with significant ownership of POS
* Must have experience leading a product team and owning the strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for Cloud, Offline, and Mobile POS
* Must have experience building enterprise-grade products requiring offline resilience, high availability, and large-scale integrations (ERP, OMS, WMS, CRM)
* Must have experience in omnichannel retail journeys including billing, payments, promotions, loyalty, and inventory visibility
* Must have experience in SaaS product lifecycle management and ERP integrations
* Must be willing to work from the Gurgaon office 5 days a week and attend a face-to-face final interview round

Work Location: In person

title: Product Manager – Amazon Ads | AdTech | SaaS
job_description:
We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven **Product Manager with a background in an Amazon Ads agency** who has hands-on experience contributing to the development and launch of a product, tool, or SaaS platform for Amazon advertising.

The ideal candidate should understand the challenges faced by Amazon advertisers, sellers, and advertising agencies and be able to translate those challenges into practical product solutions. The candidate will be responsible for improving product usability, defining features, coordinating with development teams, and ensuring that the product is market-ready, scalable, and commercially sellable.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked on taking a product from concept or development to launch, adoption, and revenue generation.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Product Development & Strategy**

* Lead product development initiatives for Amazon Ads-related tools, platforms, and software solutions.
* Translate business objectives and customer requirements into product roadmaps, feature specifications, and actionable development plans.
* Identify market gaps and opportunities within Amazon Advertising, campaign management, reporting, analytics, and automation.
* Collaborate with developers, designers, business teams, and stakeholders to deliver product features aligned with market needs.

**2. User Experience & Product Usability**

* Make the product intuitive, user-friendly, efficient, and easy to navigate for Amazon sellers, agencies, and advertisers.
* Identify usability gaps and recommend improvements to product workflows, dashboards, reporting, and overall user experience.
* Gather feedback from users and customers to continuously improve product functionality.
* Work closely with UI/UX designers and developers to simplify complex advertising processes.

**3. Commercialization & Market Readiness**

* Help transform a technically functional product into a market-ready and commercially viable solution.
* Define product positioning, value propositions, use cases, and differentiation from competing products.
* Work with sales and marketing teams to develop product demonstrations, sales enablement material, and go-to-market strategies.
* Identify target customer segments, pricing opportunities, and potential revenue models.
* Support customer onboarding, product adoption, retention, and expansion.

**4. Amazon Ads Domain Expertise**

* Understand Amazon Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, campaign optimization, keyword management, bidding, and advertising performance metrics.
* Understand the day-to-day challenges of Amazon Ads agencies and sellers and how technology can solve them.
* Identify opportunities for automation, performance reporting, campaign optimization, and operational efficiency.
* Stay informed about Amazon Ads ecosystem developments, competitor products, and customer expectations.
* And Amazon DSP also

**5. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Coordinate with engineering, design, QA, sales, marketing, and customer success teams.
* Create product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature prioritization plans.
* Manage product releases, feedback cycles, bug prioritization, and continuous improvements.
* Track product performance using adoption, engagement, customer satisfaction, retention, and revenue metrics.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 4–8 years of relevant experience in product management, product development, or product ownership.
* Prior experience working with an **Amazon Ads agency, Amazon marketplace technology provider, or e-commerce AdTech company**.
* Demonstrable experience contributing to the development, improvement, or launch of an actual software product.
* Experience making products more user-friendly, commercially viable, and attractive to target customers.
* Strong understanding of Amazon Advertising workflows, seller requirements, and agency operations.
* Ability to connect customer pain points with product features and business outcomes.
* Experience working with technical teams and translating business requirements into product specifications.
* Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience taking a product from concept or MVP to market launch.
* Experience with Amazon Ads APIs, advertising automation tools, analytics dashboards, or campaign management platforms.
* Exposure to SaaS pricing, competitor analysis, product positioning, and go-to-market planning.
* Experience conducting customer interviews, product demos, usability testing, and feedback sessions.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira, ClickUp, Asana, or similar platforms.

Key Success Metrics

* Product usability and customer adoption.
* Successful delivery of prioritized product features.
* Reduction in customer pain points and operational inefficiencies.
* Product-market fit and customer satisfaction.
* Product conversion, retention, and revenue growth.
* Successful commercialization and market positioning of the product.

Pay: ₹67,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
role: Product Manager - Liquidity & Account Solutions Product Development - Vice President
role_title: Product Manager - Liquidity & Account Solutions Product Development - Vice President
title: Product Manager - Liquidity & Account Solutions Product Development - Vice President
job_description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Shape the future of global liquidity by helping deliver modern, client-first capabilities at scale. Join a team where you will partner across product, technology, and operations to turn complex needs into delivered outcomes. Bring your product and analysis expertise to a role with strong visibility, growth opportunities, and mobility across a global payments organization.

As a Product Vice President at JPMorganChase within Payments, Liquidity and Account Solutions Product Development, you will drive delivery of money market fund capabilities as part of a multi-year liquidity platform transformation. You will act as a primary liaison between product owners and technology delivery teams to define clear requirements and enable predictable execution. You will translate current-state behaviors and client needs into a prioritized backlog of features, user stories, and acceptance criteria. You will partner with engineering, operations, user experience, and business stakeholders to deliver agreed milestones with strong quality and risk discipline. You will help ensure solutions are scalable, user-friendly, and aligned to evolving market and regulatory expectations.

This role supports a global initiative modernizing liquidity and account services for large multinational corporate and financial institution clients. The work spans multiple regions and stakeholder groups and requires strong coordination across product, technology, and operational partners. You will help close current-state gaps while defining a clear target state that supports faster product innovation and improved client experience. Success will be measured through delivery of prioritized capabilities, clarity of documentation, and effective stakeholder alignment. Coverage flexibility is required to support United States business hours through 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time, with occasional extension based on critical delivery needs.

Job Responsibilities

* **Develop** deep domain knowledge of liquidity and money market fund offerings, including client workflows, constraints, and value drivers.
* **Lead** cross-functional execution across product, engineering, operations, and regional stakeholders to deliver committed milestones.
* **Analyze** existing processes and documentation to understand current-state behavior and identify gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* **Define** target-state requirements using clear artifacts such as epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
* **Own** backlog prioritization and readiness by running refinement sessions and maintaining a delivery-ready pipeline of work.
* **Validate** sprint outcomes against acceptance criteria and coordinate timely resolution of scope and requirement questions.
* **Support** test planning and execution by ensuring scenarios cover requirements and by assisting with user acceptance testing and defect triage.
* **Drive** stakeholder communication by translating complex technical, operational, and regulatory inputs into clear decisions and next steps.
* **Contribute** to operating model and governance improvements, including disciplined risk and control practices and data/analytics ways of working.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

* Bachelor's degree and prior experience in a product manager, digital product owner, business analyst or equivalent role.
* Prior experience as a product manager, digital product owner, business analyst, or equivalent role.
* Demonstrated ability to produce and manage requirements artifacts (for example, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows).
* Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with technology teams and business stakeholders to deliver outcomes.
* Demonstrated written and verbal communication skills, including ability to simplify complex concepts for senior stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a delivery-oriented environment with strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.
* Commitment to sound risk and control practices.
* Flexibility to support business coverage needs through 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time (with occasional extensions based on delivery needs).

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

* Experience with liquidity and/or money market fund products.
* Experience working with data analysis, large datasets, and/or modeling.
* Experience using digital tools, including artificial intelligence-enabled tools, to accelerate documentation and requirements definition.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

role: Product Manager- UPI & Payments Product| Mumbai
role_title: Product Manager- UPI & Payments Product| Mumbai
title: Product Manager- UPI & Payments Product| Mumbai
job_description:
Job Description
  

To manage and enhance digital payment products, including UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, and merchant payment solutions, through product development, business growth initiatives, customer experience enhancement, regulatory compliance, and ecosystem partnerships to drive adoption and business outcomes.

  
Responsibilities
  

* Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, and merchant payment products, including product enhancements and customer experience improvements.
* Drive customer acquisition, transaction growth, product adoption, and business performance across digital payment channels.
* Lead implementation of new payment features, product enhancements, and regulatory changes in alignment with business objectives.
* Collaborate with Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Business teams to ensure seamless product delivery and execution.
* Monitor product performance, transaction success rates, operational SLAs, customer feedback, and complaint trends and implement improvement initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with RBI, NPCI, and internal governance requirements applicable to digital payment products.
* Manage relationships with NPCI, payment partners, fintechs, and ecosystem stakeholders to support product development, certifications, and strategic initiatives.
* Assess market trends, competitor offerings, and emerging payment innovations and recommend enhancements to strengthen product competitiveness.

  
Qualifications
  

Experience Range: 5 to 10 years

Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Commerce, Finance or related discipline

Postgraduation: MBA preferred.

author: Hiring Manager
title: AI Product Manager
job_description:
**Open Position: AI Product Manager**  
**Location: Malad (West), Mumbai**  
**Experience: 4+ years**  
**Qualification: Bachelor’s degree**   
**Only candidates based in Mumbai Suburban locations (Dahisar to Dadar) should apply for the Position.**

**You can also contact on: 9372974661 / 8928772622 / 7021155918**  
**We are working 6 days, i.e., from Monday to Saturday.**

**Role Summary**

Drive the roadmap and execution of an AI-powered LMS while managing the product development team. Focus on building scalable, user-friendly solutions that improve adoption and learning outcomes across industries.

**Job Description**

* Define and execute product roadmap for AI-driven LMS/LXP
* Manage and align the product development team for timely delivery
* Build AI-powered features such as personalized learning, recommendations, and chatbot interfaces
* Own end-to-end product lifecycle from requirements to release
* Work closely with enterprise clients to gather requirements and tailor solutions
* Drive product customization to suit different industries and use cases
* Prepare effort estimates and scope for new modules, enhancements, and customizations
* Improve user adoption, engagement, and overall experience
* Drive integrations with HRMS, content platforms, and collaboration tools
* Track product performance using data and analytics

**Requirements**

* 4+ years in Product Management (SaaS preferred)
* Experience in LMS, LXP, or HR Tech is a plus
* Strong understanding of AI/ML use cases in products
* Exposure to authoring tools and content creation workflows
* Experience in managing product or cross-functional development teams
* Experience in effort estimation, scoping, and requirement analysis
* Strong problem-solving and stakeholder management skills

**Good to Have**

* Experience with enterprise clients across industries
* Exposure to chatbot or conversational AI products
* Understanding of learning ecosystems and competency frameworks

**Key KPIs for This Role**

* Release Efficiency: % of features delivered on time vs planned roadmap
* Time to Market: Average time taken from feature finalization to market launch
* Wireframing Effectiveness: Time taken to convert requirements into approved wireframes
* AI Feature Impact: Usage and effectiveness of AI-driven features
* Customization Turnaround: Time taken to scope and deliver client-specific enhancements
* User Engagement: Improvement in completion rates, repeat usage, and session frequency
* Customer Feedback: Reduction in escalations and improvement in satisfaction scores
* Integration Success: Number and stability of integrations delivered
* Team Productivity: Sprint velocity, backlog closure rate, and development cycle time

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
