**Broad outline of the Role**  

* The role is responsible for the performance of the product and the KPIs related to the product in the respective areas of Network/SDWAN/Cloud and security/Unified Collaboration/Mobility and IoT/other domains. The incumbent will work closely with multi-functional areas, including sales, pricing, marketing, legal, compliance, and risk for the purpose of product management, development, product enhancement, release, or product positioning. This is an operational role, responsible for delivering results that have direct impact on the achievement of results for the product.
  

  
  
**Minimum Qualifications & Experience**  

* Bachelors Degree in engineering or business or equivalent qualification
* A Management Degree in marketing or Product Management experience is a plus.
* 4-7 years in product management/sales related experience
  

  
  
**Other Knowledge & Skills**  

* Intermediate experience in managing elements of the product development lifecycle.
* Good in productivity tools like MS word, Excel, Power-point
  

  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  

* Drive execution of product strategy

* Facilitating and being accountable for daily standups, sprint planning, and demos in a highly agile team environment.

* Work closely with engineering teams to deliver with quick time-to-market and optimal resources.

* Analyse product requirements and develop appropriate programs to ensure they're met.

* Develop, implement, and maintain production timelines across multiple departments.

* Creating and managing product manuals, user manuals, architecture diagrams, sequence flow diagrams and workflows specific to the region

* Coordinating product releases with marketing, sales, and sales support

* Drive reporting, reconciliation, governance and risk management capabilities across transaction banking products.
* Review existing processes and initiate product, process and technology enhancements to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Assess market trends, competitor offerings and emerging transaction banking opportunities and recommend product improvements.

  
Qualifications
  

Experience Range: 5 to 8 years

title: Senior Product Manager - Cloudera Manager
job_description:
**Business Area:**

Product Mgmt.

**Seniority Level:**

Mid-Senior level

**Job Description:**

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

Cloudera is seeking a Senior Product Manager for the Cloudera Manager product. This role owns the product strategy and roadmap for one of the key lifecycle management tools serving the largest global enterprises across all industries including finance, manufacturing, tech and federal. Cloudera Manager is responsible for the lifecycle of mission critical clusters with thousands of nodes and petabytes of data.

In this role, you will lead and execute on a strategy to ensure Cloudera Manager provides enterprise capabilities with the ease of data SaaS products from on-premises to cloud. You will grow Cloudera Manager to be a tool once used by engineers to an experience that is straight forward for any data platform manager. You will partner closely with Engineering, PMO, Product Marketing, and Field organizations to deliver a market-leading experience in hybrid cloud.

**As a Senior Product Manager you will:**

* **Drive Intelligent Product Experiences:** Shift the product strategy from infinite customization to a simplified user experience that provides optimal settings no matter the cluster configuration and active guardrails to eliminate operational fragility to prevent self-inflicted outages. Incorporate configuration recommendations, actionable health alerts, and actionable bad-configuration warnings directly into the product using AI trained on Cloudera’s knowledge base and real-time observability telemetry.
* **Simplify Accessibility for IT Generalists:** Design intuitive workflows and self-guided administrative tools tailored for IT generalists with minimal big data expertise, making documentation a secondary resource and lowering the barrier to platform management.
* **Embed Intelligence:** **Execute Hybrid Architecture Modernization:** Lead the long-term evolution of Cloudera Manager into an orchestrator of clusters across multiple clouds allowing customers to deploy use cases in a hybrid cloud topology.
* **Achieve Uninterrupted Core Operations at Scale:** Optimize fundamental cluster lifecycle operations to manage environments up to 10,000 nodes, ensuring refresh and maintenance operations on 1,000+ node clusters execute within customer approved SLAs.
* **Define Predictable Lifecycle & API Guarantees:** Establish and enforce structured release lifecycle policies that guarantee public API stability and backward compatibility to remove upgrade friction for enterprise customers.
* **Track Operational Success Metrics:** Monitor and continuously improve key performance indicators, specifically focusing on increasing operational velocity, boosting prescriptive feature adoption rates, and reducing support escalation volumes.

**We are excited if you have:**

  

* Bsc/Msc in related field or equivalent experience
* **Enterprise Platform Experience:** 5+ years of experience in the enterprise software space with at least 2 years of Product Management experience. Strong foundational understanding of open datalakes, data movement, enterprise data governance, and big data architecture.
* **On-Premise Knowledge:** Basic technical understanding of virtualization, data center networking
* **Public Cloud Knowledge:** Basic technical understanding of VM-based public cloud deployments (IaaS/PaaS), object storage architectures (S3, ADLS, GCS), and network architectures for at least one major hyperscaler (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform).
* **Simplification & UX Modernization:** Demonstrated success in transforming complex, developer-centric platforms into intuitive, "opinionated" products with active guardrails that eliminate manual operational friction.

**You might also have:**

* **CSP Partner Ecosystem Experience:** Direct experience working with or within major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), including partner co-development, cloud marketplace programs, or cloud-native integrations.
* **Competitive Landscape Awareness:** Strong knowledge of modern cloud data platforms and competitive solutions, such as Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery/Bigtable, Amazon EMR/Redshift, or Azure Synapse.
* **Modern Datalakehouse Formats:** Familiarity with open table formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg) and multi-cloud data architecture strategies.
* **Data Platform Administrative Experience:** Strong background with managing enterprise platforms or supporting customers running enterprise scale deployments with over 100 Terabytes of data.

**What you can expect from us:**

* Generous PTO Policy
* Support work life balance with Unplugged Days
* Flexible WFH Policy
* Mental & Physical Wellness programs
* Phone and Internet Reimbursement program
* Access to Continued Career Development
* Comprehensive Benefits and Competitive Packages
* Paid Volunteer Time
* Employee Resource Groups

EEO/VEVRAA

* R024224

* Pune, Maharashtra, India

* IT Operations

* Regular

  

**Location Details:** **Pune, Hybrid**

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time, others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.

This position may be a hybrid or fully remote position, as decided by your manager. If designated as hybrid, you’ll divide your time between working remotely from your home and an office location, so you should live within commuting distance. If designated as remote, you’ll be working remotely from your home and may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings. Your hiring manager can share more about this role’s hybrid or remote designation.

**Join Our Team...**

At GoDaddy, we are driven by our mission to make opportunity more inclusive. We are looking for a dedicated Senior Product Manager to join our Risk Services team in India. This role offers the flexibility of remote work alongside in-person collaboration.

As a Senior PM on the Risk Services team, you'll have the outstanding opportunity to build trust across GoDaddy’s brands, products, and services. We aim to protect our customers, partners, and vendors from bad actors and help prevent, detect, and recover from financial, reputational, and customer data loss. Working with us means you'll be part of a world-class team, passionately dedicated to delivering flawless solutions to manage and mitigate risk.

**What you'll get to do...**

In this role, you will work across the entire GoDaddy organization to address account risks. You will evolve our risk management capabilities to power solutions that balance risk and business performance.

* Leading product strategy for account risk management by crafting adaptable capabilities that can be applied across all risk areas.
* Defining requirements and the roadmap for platform and internal tools supports low reaction time, coverage, and precision. This helps meet the needs of an ever-changing risk landscape.
* Working closely with business, engineering, operational, and design collaborators across GoDaddy brands and units to measure risk gaps. We find opportunities to improve performance and build scalable solutions.
* Supporting measures to bolster our account risk management framework while encouraging business progress and elevated customer experience.
* Leading discussions with senior leaders on business performance and opportunities within the risk management space.

**Your experience should include...**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/other technical/engineering field or equivalent applicable experience.
* 5+ years of experience in Product Management or equivalent capability for an eCommerce web services product.
* Experience applying strong business insight and technical vision for a product area and using both technical and operational capabilities to build solutions.
* Demonstrated success managing medium to large complex projects in an eCommerce setting.
* Proficiency with web services, generative and agentic AI, and API development, with a curiosity to always learn more in this ever-changing technical landscape.

**You might also have...**

* Master's degree in a technology or business-related field, or equivalent experience.
* Direct experience in risk management or payments within a large-scale eCommerce setting.
* Experience bringing to bear rules engine and machine learning techniques for anomaly detection.

*We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.*

**We've got your back...**We offer a range of total rewards that may include paid time off, retirement savings (e.g., 401k, pension schemes), bonus/incentive eligibility, equity grants, participation in our employee stock purchase plan, competitive health benefits, and other family-friendly benefits including parental leave. GoDaddy’s benefits vary based on individual role and location and can be reviewed in more detail during the interview process.

**About us...** GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit About Us.

At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products—period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences and perspectives. But we also know that’s not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. That’s why we prioritize integrating diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging principles into the core of how we work every day—focusing not only on our employee experience, but also our customer experience and operations. It’s the best way to serve our mission of empowering entrepreneurs everywhere, and making opportunity more inclusive for all. To read more about these commitments, as well as our representation and pay equity data, check out our Diversity and Pay Parity annual report which can be found on our Diversity Careers page.

We also embrace our diverse culture and offer a range of Employee Resource Groups (Culture). Have a side hustle? No problem. We love entrepreneurs! Most importantly, come as you are and make your own way.

*GoDaddy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer**.* *GoDaddy will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements.* *Refer to our full* *EEO policy.*

Our recruiting team is available to assist you in completing your application. If they could be helpful, please reach out to myrecruiter@godaddy.com.

**GoDaddy doesn’t accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.**

title: Senior Product Manager - APAC
job_description:
Date live: 10/22/2026

Business Area: Investing and Lending

Area of Expertise: Investment Banking

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000131619

  

Join us as Senior Product Manager - APAC, where you will be responsible for the development and oversight of our loan and overdraft products across India, broader Asia and the Middle East. You will work closely with loan originators and broader stakeholders across the region, including coordinating new product approvals, performing annual product reviews, and acting as the business product owner in the region to help prioritise technology and process changes. You will also work closely with Operations and Technology on the rollout of our strategic loan platform across the region. The role will sit with our Investment Banking Origination team in Mumbai and report jointly to the Global Head of Loan Product Management and the Global Head of Loan Transformation.

  
  

To be successful in this role, you should:

Be a strong and ambitious candidate at Vice President level with strong product management, business analysis, stakeholder management and loan product knowledge, along with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

  
  

Essential Skills/Basic Qualifications:

* Strong business analysis skills, including the ability to capture key requirements.
* Strong bilateral and syndicated loan product knowledge.
* Strong communication, relationship management and networking skills.
* Strong product management skills.
* Ability to capture key requirements and summarise them into management-style presentations and proposals.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
* Ability to challenge existing ways of working and drive process improvements.
  

  

Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications:

* Good presentation and PowerPoint skills.
* Understanding of process design, optimisation and ownership, with a focus on client outcomes and operational effectiveness.
* Exposure to product ownership models within complex, multi-stakeholder organisations.
* Understanding of regulatory requirements and controls within lending processes.
* Experience working in agile or hybrid delivery environments.
  

  

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as:

* Contributing to and influencing policies and procedures for the function, and planning, managing and consulting on multiple complex and critical strategic projects which may be business-wide.
* Providing expert advice to business and functional management and committees to influence decisions.
* Escalating breaches of policies and procedures appropriately.
* Fostering and guiding compliance, ensuring regulations are observed and relevant processes are in place to facilitate adherence.
* Focusing on the external environment, regulators or advocacy groups to both monitor and influence on behalf of Barclays, when appropriate.
* Maintaining broad and comprehensive knowledge of industry theories and practices within the relevant discipline, alongside up-to-date sector and functional knowledge and insight into external market developments and initiatives.
* Negotiating with and influencing stakeholders at a senior level, both internally and externally.
* Acting as a principal contact point for key clients and counterparts in other functions and business divisions.
* Acting as a mandated spokesperson for the function and business division.
  

  

Job location is Mumbai.

**Purpose of the role**

To develop and manage the wholesale lending products and services, collaborating with, and ensuring service standards are complied with by, business partners across the bank, including investment bankers, credit analysts, risk managers, and operations professionals, to ensure that our products meet the needs of the bank's clients and are aligned with the bank's overall strategic objectives whilst ensuring all governance, control, regulatory and legal requirements are met.

**Accountabilities**

* Development and execution of product strategy for financial products and services offered within the wholesale division. .
* Identification of investments opportunities and customer needs to create new products or enhance existing ones. .
* Management of the entire product lifecycle, including product planning, development, launch, and ongoing management, including oversight of service levels. .
* Analysis of market data to make informed decisions regarding product positioning and pricing. .
* Assessment and management of risks associated with lending products and implement risk mitigation strategies, including the operation of and attendance to governance forums. .
* Oversight of regulatory and technological change.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Sr. Product Manager - Reputation Management
job_description:
**ABOUT US**

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

**OUR PEOPLE**

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

**OUR IMPACT**

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We're proud to be a part of that.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Marketing Products OS team builds products that help businesses attract customers, increase engagement, and drive measurable business outcomes. The team owns a diverse portfolio including Reputation Management, Dashboard & Reporting, Blogging, Social Planner, Email Marketing, Chat Widget, Affiliate Manager, Template Library, Brand Boards, and other growth-focused products.
  
  
Reputation Management is a strategic investment area for HighLevel, focused on helping businesses build trust, improve local visibility, and accelerate growth through customer reviews. Our vision is to evolve the product from a review management solution into an AI-powered reputation growth platform that enables businesses to generate more reviews, automate engagement, respond intelligently to customer feedback, and gain actionable insights that strengthen their online presence at scale.

**CORE AREAS OF OWNERSHIP**

* **Product Strategy & Roadmap :** Define the vision, strategy, north-star metrics, and 12–18 month roadmap for Reputation Management. Drive prioritization, investment decisions, and business outcomes.

* **Review Growth** : Drive review acquisition through automated campaigns, multi-channel requests, personalization, experimentation, and conversion optimization.

* **AI-Powered Engagement :** Build AI-driven review reply experiences, including personalized responses, brand voice customization, sentiment awareness, and bulk actions.

* **Reputation Automation :** Create automation-first workflows for review requests, sentiment-based routing, escalations, notifications, and proactive engagement.

* **Review Management :** Improve review monitoring, aggregation, moderation, collaboration, and multi-location management for agencies and businesses at scale.

* **Analytics & Insights :** Deliver reputation reporting, sentiment analysis, AI-generated insights, benchmarking, and recommendations that help customers take action.

* **Product Discovery & Customer Research :** Lead customer interviews, workflow audits, usability testing, competitive analysis, and market research to identify opportunities and validate solutions.

* **Product Execution :** Own PRDs, requirements, prioritization, release planning, stakeholder alignment, success metrics, and post-launch measurement to ensure outcomes are achieved.

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING**

* **7+ years** in product management, scaling 0-1 products, B2B SaaS experience or building any AI agentic products.
* Strong analytical and technical fluency:

  + Comfortable partnering with Engineering/Data on data flows, instrumentation, system design, and reliability
  + Can define robust metrics and measurement plans
  + Can reason about APIs, permissions, and scalable configuration frameworks
* Proven track record of moving business metrics (retention, expansion, adoption, support deflection, engagement)
* Demonstrated ability to lead without authority, influence cross-functional partners, and drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Data, and GTM
* Excellent written and verbal communication; can create crisp narratives for executives and individual contributors

**FIRST 12 MONTHS: HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED**

* **0–3 months: Foundation.** Validate customer problems, set baseline metrics, and get a prioritized 12–18 month roadmap approved.
* **3–6 months: Growth & AI adoption.** Launch AI review replies and expand automation, increasing review volume, response rates, and engagement.
* **6–12 months: Intelligent reputation platform.** Ship advanced automations, AI insights, enterprise multi-location support, and analytics, making Reputation Management a key driver of growth and retention.

**HighLevel is an exciting place to work as it gives adrenaline to build and help our user base.**

* We take care of our team so our team can take care of our users
* It’s never somebody else’s job - Take ownership as a company owner
* We are passionately focussed on adding value for our users
* We deliver fast using lean principles (Agile framework). We go to market in weeks instead of quarters
* A good innovative idea always gets tested and we deliver based on feedbacks
* We embrace that improvement is constant and iterative.
* Constant Learning Growth graph - You will learn how to scale B2B SaaS Startup and build relevant, impactful products for customers
* We are do-ers and go-getters to achieve team adoptions

**EEO Statement:**

The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.  
  
We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Software Product Manager
job_description:
### **About Us**

Phenom Cloud is not your average consultancy. HR is our home turf: we help clients solve their trickiest people-tech puzzles with smart, innovative solutions, backed by strong partnerships with leading HR technology vendors. Our clients operate in complex, highly regulated industries such as advanced manufacturing, life sciences, pharma, retail, and financial services, where "trusted relationship" is a real requirement, not a buzzword in a pitch deck.

What really sets us apart is our people. We know our stuff, we don't take ourselves too seriously, and yes, we are genuinely fun to be around (our clients said so, and we didn't even pay them). Through it all, we keep client excellence at the heart of everything we do. We are not a quick fling: we are a reliable, credible partner who remembers our clients' birthdays, shows up on time, and is still around years later.

### **Position Summary**

If that sounds like your kind of place, and you're a product leader who loves turning great ideas into great software (and isn't afraid to roll up your sleeves to make it happen), we should talk.

We're looking for a **Senior Software Product Management** professional to lead the strategy, execution, and growth of Phenom Cloud's expanding portfolio of enterprise software products, including innovative AI-powered solutions.

This isn't a role for someone who just manages roadmaps, attends sprint reviews, and asks engineering for status updates. We need someone who takes real ownership, understands how software actually works, knows what customers need, and can turn product challenges into opportunities.

You'll have end-to-end accountability for product strategy, quality, prioritization, and delivery. That means quickly understanding our existing products, identifying what needs improvement, establishing clear priorities, and working closely with engineering to turn requirements into software that actually delivers.

But this isn't just about making products work better. It's about making them more valuable. You'll study the market, understand competitors, identify opportunities for differentiation, and help shape products customers genuinely want to buy.

You'll work directly with executive leadership, collaborate across product and engineering teams, and have meaningful influence over the direction of our software business. We're a growing company, so expect to wear multiple hats. If your ideal role involves a large team handling all the details while you focus exclusively on strategy, this probably isn't your gig.

**For the right entrepreneurial product leader, this is a rare opportunity to take real ownership, make a visible impact, and help scale an innovative software portfolio without navigating layers of corporate bureaucracy.**

### **Duties & Responsibilities**

* Own the strategy, roadmap, quality, prioritization, and overall success of Phenom Cloud's software product portfolio
* Quickly assess existing products, identify functional gaps and usability issues, and drive improvements that make a real difference to customers
* Establish clear product priorities, balancing critical fixes, customer needs, technical considerations, and strategic enhancements
* Lead and coordinate product management activities, providing direction, accountability, and oversight across the product lifecycle
* Partner closely with engineering to translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Drive agile execution through sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and release readiness. We're big fans of shipping great software, not just talking about it
* Ensure delivered functionality meets requirements, quality standards, and customer expectations
* Conduct market and competitive analysis to identify opportunities for innovation, differentiation, and commercial growth
* Develop and execute product roadmaps that connect customer needs, market opportunities, and business objectives
* Collaborate with customers, sales, marketing, and delivery teams to gather feedback, shape product direction, and support go-to-market activities
* Identify opportunities to expand product capabilities, introduce new offerings, and grow recurring software revenue
* Establish practical, scalable product management processes without turning a fast-moving company into a bureaucracy

### **Skills & Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in software product management, technical product ownership, or a closely related role
* Proven experience managing software products through requirements, development, testing, release, and continuous improvement
* Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, sprint management, backlog prioritization, and software development lifecycles
* Ability to translate complex business needs into clear functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Strong technical aptitude and the confidence to challenge engineering assumptions, evaluate trade-offs, and get into the details when needed
* Experience diagnosing product issues, prioritizing improvements, and driving problems through to resolution
* Strong commercial instincts and the ability to connect product strategy with customer needs, competitive positioning, and business growth
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, particularly when things aren't neatly documented or clearly defined
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams, establish accountability, and keep development moving without needing a small army of project managers
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias toward action. You'd rather solve a problem than schedule another meeting to discuss it
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage confidently with engineers, customers, and executives alike
* Ability to use AI to improve productivity and accelerate product development without sacrificing independent thinking, creativity, or sound judgment
* A genuinely great teammate who is collaborative, approachable, and fun to work with. We value smart people with small egos and a sense of humor

### **Some Nice-To-Haves**

* Experience with B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or subscription-based products
* Background in HR technology, learning management systems, talent management, or workforce technology
* Experience with AI-powered products, workflow automation, or enterprise software integrations
* Track record of launching, scaling, or commercializing software products
* Experience leading product owners, product managers, or cross-functional development teams
* Familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar product management tools
* Experience in a startup, scale-up, or entrepreneurial software environment where wearing multiple hats comes with the territory

### **Benefits**

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits package (medical, dental, vision, 401K)
* Remote working
* Generous paid time off and company holidays
* Opportunity to take full ownership of a growing software portfolio and directly influence product strategy, innovation, and commercial success
* Direct access to executive leadership and meaningful influence over the growth and direction of our software business
* Career growth opportunities as our software portfolio and product organization continue to scale
* Creative, entrepreneurial environment where decisions happen quickly, great ideas are encouraged, and bureaucracy is kept to a minimum
* Surround yourself with people who are great at what they do and even better at not taking themselves too seriously

author: Hiring Manager
title: Sr. Product Manager I
job_description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it's what we show up for every day.

We are looking to hire a Senior Product Manager I to own the integrations and agentic ecosystem for Brandfolder, Smartsheet's Digital Asset Management platform. This is a high-growth, strategically critical product area. It covers how Brandfolder connects to the tools where marketing and creative teams work, and how AI agents find, use and govern brand content through MCP, connectors, APIs and partner integrations.

Your work will determine whether Brandfolder is the trusted source of brand content for people and AI agents alike. This is an individual contributor role for a product leader with strong technical fluency, deep customer instincts and the confidence to drive a complex, cross-surface product area across multiple engineering teams and external partners.

**You Will**
------------

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for Brandfolder's MCP server, connector framework, public API and integrations and make clear prioritization and sequencing decisions
* Define how AI agents such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Copilot discover, retrieve, create and update brand assets, while keeping permissions, usage rights and brand governance intact
* Lead the evolution of Brandfolder's integration portfolio
* Define the API and agent-readiness strategy: authentication, scopes, rate limits, webhooks, tool design and developer experience for customers, partners and AI clients
* Own the quality, reliability and supportability of existing integrations, and shape the migration path from legacy connectors to the new platform
* Lead customer and partner discovery sessions to validate assumptions
* Author crisp product briefs, requirements and technical specs that design and engineering can execute without ambiguity, from discovery through GA and post-launch
* Drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, design, security, GTM, Customer Success, Support and partner teams
* Define success metrics for every feature, such as integration adoption, active accounts, agent task success, API usage and work with data teams to ensure instrumentation from day one
* Represent product in leadership reviews, MBRs, partner conversations and customer engagements
* Contribute to packaging and pricing decisions for integrations and AI capabilities

**You Have**
------------

* 4+ years of product management experience delivering high-impact features in enterprise SaaS or B2B software
* Experience owning platform, API, integration, connectors or developer-facing product areas, including how products work with AI models and agents is a strong plus
* Experience with content, digital asset management, marketing technology or workflow products is a plus
* Proven ability to navigate ambiguous, technically complex problem spaces and make clear scoping and sequencing decisions across multiple engineering teams and external partners
* A working understanding of authentication and authorization (OAuth, SSO, role-based permissions), APIs and webhooks, and data security considerations for AI
* Strong customer instincts: you run structured discovery, synthesize signal and turn it into well-scoped, validated decisions
* A track record of excellent product briefs, requirements and specs that engineering acts on without ambiguity
* Demonstrated ability to drive alignment across engineering, design, security, GTM and Customer Success, including third-party partner dependencies
* A data-driven mindset: you define adoption, funnel, quality and reliability metrics before you ship and use post-launch data to guide iteration
* Excellent written and verbal communication

**Get to Know Us:**

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You'll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you're doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that's magic at work. Let's build what's next, together.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

* Represent product in leadership reviews, MBRs, partner conversations and customer engagements
* Contribute to packaging and pricing decisions for integrations and AI capabilities

**You Have**
------------

* 4+ years of product management experience delivering high-impact features in enterprise SaaS or B2B software
* Experience owning platform, API, integration, connectors or developer-facing product areas, including how products work with AI models and agents is a strong plus
* Experience with content, digital asset management, marketing technology or workflow products is a plus
* Proven ability to navigate ambiguous, technically complex problem spaces and make clear scoping and sequencing decisions across multiple engineering teams and external partners
* A working understanding of authentication and authorization (OAuth, SSO, role-based permissions), APIs and webhooks, and data security considerations for AI
* Strong customer instincts: you run structured discovery, synthesize signal and turn it into well-scoped, validated decisions
* A track record of excellent product briefs, requirements and specs that engineering acts on without ambiguity
* Demonstrated ability to drive alignment across engineering, design, security, GTM and Customer Success, including third-party partner dependencies
* A data-driven mindset: you define adoption, funnel, quality and reliability metrics before you ship and use post-launch data to guide iteration
* Excellent written and verbal communication

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You'll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you're doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that's magic at work. Let's build what's next, together.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Staff Product Manager
job_description:
Build the field software that helps maintain and update information about the network for Electric, Gas, Water or Telecommunications.
  
When work happens in the Field, whether its event driven, maintenance activities, or other planned work, We build the software those crews and Field Engineers use. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead continued improvements to the products at the center of that work: GridOS Field and its unified App and User Experience. One field app supporting many complex business flows and outcomes
  
This role owns how utility field workers capture critical information while performing work. Your decisions will shape how quickly and efficiently utilities capture and maintain data that is constantly changing in the Field.

**Job Description**
===================

Own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery for product and workflow inside GridOS Field. Your day to day will include:

* **Owning the roadmap.** Set direction for new workflows and enhancements to GridOS Field. Prioritize based on customer needs, technology changes, regulatory drivers, and business impact.
* **Working with customers.** Spend time with utility damage assessors, field supervisors, and control room staff. Validate real problems before writing a single requirement.
* **Working with your Peer Product Management teams who also manage the product lifecycle of GridOS Field**
* **Driving delivery.** Partner with engineering, design, and UX to ship high quality releases on a predictable cadence. Support the Lean operating rhythm.
* **Working with Requirements Management tools: These** tools help document and drive the roadmaps and priorities that help shape strategy, delivery and on-going improvements to GridOS Field
* **Connecting to the platform.** Make sure your products feel like one app with the rest of GridOS Field. Work with the UX PM and the other GridOS Field PMs to keep the experience unified.
* **Using AI.** Apply AI to speed up damage triage, image capture workflows, and data quality checks. Use AI tools in your own workflow to move faster.
* **Supporting sales and delivery.** Join customer calls, write positioning material, and help account teams win and deliver deals with Southern Company, PPL, and the accounts that follow them.
* **Guiding customers off legacy.** Help utilities move from FieldSmart, AEMS, and other legacy tools onto the modern GridOS Field platform.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* Product management or other Management experience with complex enterprise software, ideally in utilities, energy, telecom, or another regulated industry.
* Working knowledge of utility field operations, outage restoration, or ADMS/DMS/OMS and other Field Maintenance Flows. If you have not lived it, you have shipped software to people who have.
* A track record of running more than one program at a time with a clear, data-driven approach.
* Comfort with AI tools in your own product workflow.
* Strong writing and communication. You can turn a messy customer conversation into a clear requirement, a crisp roadmap update, or a one-page memo.
* Commercial judgment. You can connect a product decision to a revenue, cost, or customer outcome.
* A Lean and Agile mindset. You adjust quickly when priorities shift, and you close things out.

**Education Requirements**
--------------------------

**For US candidates:** A Master's degree, or a High School Diploma/GED with at least six years of professional experience.

**For non-US candidates:** A Master's equivalent, or a High School Diploma with relevant professional experience.

**Why Join Us**
---------------

You will work on software that utilities depend on during their most challenging times to maintain infrastructure stability while experiencing exponential growth in demand. restoring service.

We offer:

* **Real impact.** Providing Value to Large Tier 1 and Tier2 Utility and Telco companies, with a clear runway to grow.
* **Modern stack.** Single-tenant SaaS on hyperscaler infrastructure, with AI built in through the Prism platform.
* **Direct customer contact.** You talk to the people using the product, not just the people buying it.
* **Growth.** GridOS Field is scaling. Strong PMs move up.

**Success in This Role**
------------------------

You will know you are succeeding when the Adoption rate of GridOS Field increasing and becomes a key part of both our existing customer base and prospects.

**Working Arrangement**
-----------------------

Permanent, fully remote. Occasional travel to customer sites and GE Vernova offices.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from everyone who meets the criteria and is interested in the future of the grid.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

author: Hiring Manager
title: Technical Product Manager - Principal
job_description:
**Senior Product Manager / Solutions Architect – Design Automation & AI Workflows**
===================================================================================

**Company Overview**  
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

**Want to Help Shape How Chips Are Designed in the Future?**

* How would you automate workflows that have traditionally required years of engineering expertise?
* How would you combine AI, optimization, and domain knowledge to solve challenging problems across analog, custom digital, and standard cell design?
* How would you help customers migrate decades of intellectual property between design environments?
* How would you create products that make engineers dramatically more productive while improving design quality?
* How would you take breakthrough ideas from concept to deployment at the world's leading semiconductor companies?

That's what we do. We're looking for people who are excited about solving difficult problems and making a meaningful impact. You'll work at the intersection of semiconductor design, AI, product strategy, and customer engagement. The ideal candidate understands complex design challenges, can translate customer needs into product requirements, and enjoys helping bring innovative technologies from concept to production.

**Responsibilities**

* Define product requirements and workflows for next-generation design automation solutions.
* Work directly with customers to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and validate proposed solutions.
* Drive product direction for technologies across analog design, standard cell design, custom digital implementation, design migration, and design automation.
* Partner closely with engineering teams to translate customer needs into product capabilities and deliverables.
* Define use cases, success metrics, benchmarks, and customer adoption strategies.
* Lead evaluations, demonstrations, customer engagements, and early-access deployments.
* Influence roadmap priorities based on market needs, customer feedback, and competitive analysis.

**Requirements**

* BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience in semiconductor design, EDA, or related technical fields.
* Experience defining solutions, workflows, or products that have been successfully delivered to users or customers.
* Experience applying automation, AI, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic AI technologies to engineering workflows.
* Strong understanding of one or more of the following domains:
  + Analog and custom IC design
  + Standard cell design and optimization
  + Physical implementation
  + Design migration and design reuse
  + Semiconductor design automation
  + Physical verification, extraction, and simulation workflows
* Experience working directly with customers to gather requirements and drive technology adoption.
* Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively across product management, engineering, sales, and customer teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Analog and custom IC design workflows.
* Circuit simulation, SPICE, and analog verification flows.
* DRC, LVS, parasitic extraction, and physical verification.
* OpenAccess-based design environments.
* Experience with commercial EDA platforms such as Cadence Virtuoso.
* Delivering software products used in production semiconductor design flows.
* Technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration.

We are looking for product leaders who are excited by emerging technology, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to help shape the future of semiconductor design. Success in this role requires a combination of technical depth, customer focus, business judgment, and the ability to turn innovative ideas into widely adopted solutions.

**Why us?**  
Working at Siemens Software means flexibility — choosing between working at home and the office (with state-of-the-art facilities in Bangalore and Noida) at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

title: Sr. Product Manager I - Data Mesh
job_description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it's what we show up for every day.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own DataMesh, one of Smartsheet's most widely used cross-sheet data capabilities and a critical part of how enterprise customers build and run their solutions today. DataMesh sits at the centre of a multi-year shift in Smartsheet's data model, as we evolve towards column links and, ultimately, relational data capabilities.

**You Will:**

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for DataMesh, balancing near-term stability and customer needs against the longer-term migration strategy
* Own the operational stability and serviceability of DataMesh, partnering with engineering and Support to prioritise defects, performance issues, and escalations
* Shape and execute the migration path from DataMesh to column links, working closely with the Data Links PM on feature parity, the advanced column links roadmap, and report-as-a-source as a critical dependency
* Lead customer and user discovery with enterprise personas (work admins, solution builders, system administrators, and power users) to understand how DataMesh is used in practice, identify migration blockers, and validate decisions before they ship
* Partner with Customer Success and GTM to plan communications, enablement, and migration support for enterprise accounts that depend on DataMesh
* Work with one or more engineering squads, navigating dependencies and making clear scoping and sequencing decisions across a complex, interconnected backlog
* Author clear product briefs, requirements docs, and feature specs that design and engineering can execute on without ambiguity
* Define success metrics for everything you ship, including DataMesh usage, migration progress, and quality indicators, and partner with data and analytics teams on instrumentation and reporting
* Represent DataMesh in leadership reviews, WBRs, and customer conversations, including enterprise account engagements
* Perform other duties as assigned

**You Have:**

* 4+ years of product management experience delivering features within enterprise SaaS or B2B software products
* Experience with data management, data modelling, workflow automation, platform integrations, or cross-sheet data referencing is a strong plus
* Experience managing a mature product through sustain, deprecation, or migration phases is a plus
* Strong customer instincts: you can run structured discovery, synthesise customer feedback, and turn it into well-scoped, validated product decisions
* A track record of writing product briefs, requirements docs, and specs that engineering and design can act on without ambiguity
* Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, design, GTM, and Customer Success
* Comfort working with engineering teams across time zones, including stakeholders in North America
* A data-driven mindset: you define adoption and quality metrics before you ship and use post-launch data to guide iteration
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including confidence presenting in leadership reviews and speaking directly with enterprise customers
* Familiarity with API-driven product development or working alongside platform engineering teams is a plus
* Legally eligible to work in India on an ongoing basis
* Fluency in English is required

**Get to Know Us:**

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You'll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you're doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that's magic at work. Let's build what's next, together.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

* 3+ years of experience with the Agile methodology
* Product Owner certification (CSPO from Scrum Alliance)

* Domain expert in business applications

* Highly developed interpersonal skills to deal with sensitive, emotional or potentially controversial situations.
Excellent oral and written communication skills

**Experience required:** 3-4 years

  

Summary: The main function of a Product Owner is to analyze science, engineering, business and all other data processing problems for application to electronic data processing systems. A typical Product Owner is responsible for analyzing user requirements, procedures and problems to automate or improve existing systems and review computer system capabilities, workflow and scheduling limitations.

  

Job Responsibilities:

* Gather requirements from business units and translate those to programmers and developers.
* Prepare cost-benefit and return-on-investment analyses to aid in decisions on system implementation.
* Confer with clients regarding the nature of the information processing or computation needs.
* Coordinate and link the computer systems within an organization to increase compatibility and so information can be shared.
  

Skills:

* Verbal and written communication skills, problem solving skills, attention to detail and interpersonal skills.
* Basic ability to work independently and manage one’s time.
* Basic knowledge of design techniques and principles involved in production of drawings and models.
* Basic knowledge of computer software, such as Visual Basic, Java, SQL, etc.
  

Education/Relevant Experience: Bachelor's degree in a technical field such as computer science, computer engineering or related field required. MBA or other related advanced degree preferred. 3-4 years Relevant Experience required.

**Position Overview**

  
  

Autodesk is seeking a strategic and technically skilled Senior Product Manager to lead the modernization of our Marketing Technology (MarTech) ecosystem, with a primary focus on end-to-end Lead Management and pipeline progression.

In this role, you will define and execute product strategy across the lead lifecycle, from lead capture, enrichment, scoring, qualification, routing, and engagement through pipeline progression and conversion. You will collaborate closely with Attribution, Analytics, Data, and Go-to-Market (GTM) teams to ensure Lead Management capabilities are seamlessly connected across the broader MarTech ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in Marketing Technology and Lead Management with strong product management skills and a passion for leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) to transform how leads are identified, qualified, prioritized, engaged, and converted.

You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Data Science, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Analytics teams to build intelligent, scalable solutions that improve lead quality, optimize seller productivity, accelerate pipeline progression, and drive revenue growth.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

  
  

* Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for the MarTech portfolio, focusing on end-to-end Lead Management and pipeline progression while aligning technology investments with business objectives
* Lead the evolution of the Lead Management ecosystem, including lead capture, lifecycle management, enrichment, deduplication, scoring, qualification, routing, prioritization, engagement, and conversion
* Own the end-to-end lead-to-revenue experience, identifying opportunities to reduce friction and optimize conversion across every stage of the sales funnel
* Partner with Data Science and Engineering teams to develop and enhance Machine Learning (ML) and predictive models for lead scoring, qualification, prioritization, and conversion
* Drive AI-powered lead engagement and qualification through AI agents, AI-powered Sales Development Representative (AI-SDR) capabilities, and Copilot solutions that automate repetitive workflows, improve lead coverage, and provide sellers with timely, actionable insights
* Define strategies to improve lead quality and enrichment by leveraging first-party and external data sources to provide relevant context for qualification, scoring, routing, and seller engagement
* Establish measurable strategies and feedback loops to continuously improve lead scoring, qualification, routing, and conversion performance
* Partner with the Marketing Attribution Product Manager to define requirements and ensure attribution capabilities support end-to-end lead-to-pipeline measurement and decision-making
* Collaborate with GTM Product Managers to drive cross-functional initiatives and ensure Lead Management capabilities integrate seamlessly across Customer Relationship Management (CRM), marketing automation, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), analytics, advertising, and other GTM systems
* Define product requirements, prioritize roadmaps, and collaborate with Engineering, User Experience (UX), Architecture, Technical Program Management, and Data teams to deliver high-impact solutions
* Leverage data, experimentation, and customer insights to identify opportunities, measure product success, and continuously improve lead-to-revenue outcomes
* Build strong relationships with Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, Data Science, Finance, and executive stakeholders to align product investments with business priorities
* Champion AI innovation, experimentation, automation, and continuous improvement across the Lead Management ecosystem
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  
  

* 10+ years of Product Management experience, including significant experience in Marketing Technology, Lead Management, or Go-to-Market (GTM) technology
* Deep expertise in end-to-end Lead Management, including lead lifecycle management, enrichment, scoring, qualification, routing, prioritization, engagement, and pipeline progression
* Strong understanding of modern GTM systems, including Customer Relationship Management (CRM), marketing automation, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Business Intelligence (BI) platforms, and sales engagement technologies
* Experience developing data-driven products and collaborating with Data Science or Machine Learning teams
* Strong understanding of lead scoring methodologies, predictive models, lead qualification, conversion optimization, and marketing measurement
* Proven ability to translate complex lead-to-revenue processes and business requirements into scalable product solutions
* Experience defining and measuring product Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), experimentation frameworks, and business outcomes
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with demonstrated experience influencing senior leadership across Marketing, Sales, and Technology organizations
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives involving Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data, User Experience, Operations, and Business teams
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  
  

* Experience with Salesforce, Marketo, 6sense, Microsoft Power BI, Adobe Experience Platform, Customer Data Platforms, or similar Marketing Technology and GTM solutions
* Experience designing and launching AI-powered user experiences, AI agents, Copilot solutions, AI-powered Sales Development Representative capabilities, or Generative AI features for enterprise applications
* Experience developing or optimizing Machine Learning-based lead scoring, predictive lead qualification, or propensity models
* Experience with lead enrichment, identity resolution, data quality, and integration of external data providers into Lead Management workflows
* Familiarity with marketing attribution, experimentation, predictive analytics, and customer journey optimization
  

  

**The Ideal Candidate**

  
  

The ideal candidate is a strategic and technically accomplished Product Management professional who combines deep Marketing Technology expertise, analytical thinking, and cross-functional leadership to modernize Lead Management capabilities and deliver measurable business outcomes

  
  

* Demonstrates strong product leadership and a clear vision for modernizing and simplifying Lead Management through scalable, integrated technology solutions
* Applies deep knowledge of lead lifecycle management, marketing automation, and GTM systems to improve lead quality, qualification, and conversion
* Uses data, experimentation, and sound judgment to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and drive measurable improvements in business performance
* Leverages Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to develop intelligent lead scoring, enrichment, qualification, prioritization, and routing capabilities
* Improves seller productivity by ensuring Sales teams receive qualified leads with relevant context at the appropriate time
* Drives AI-powered lead engagement and qualification to reduce manual effort, improve lead coverage, and accelerate response times
* Identifies and removes friction across the lead-to-pipeline journey to improve conversion rates and accelerate revenue opportunities
* Establishes closed-loop measurement and feedback mechanisms to continuously improve lead scoring, qualification, engagement, and conversion
* Builds trusted partnerships across Attribution, Analytics, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, Engineering, and GTM teams to deliver connected insights across the lead-to-revenue lifecycle
* Identifies opportunities to streamline operational processes through automation, AI-powered workflows, and scalable technology solutions
* Collaborates effectively across the GTM product portfolio to strengthen Marketing and Sales alignment and improve organizational productivity
* Influences strategic direction and serves as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology leaders
* Demonstrates strong ownership, adaptability, and a commitment to delivering measurable improvements in lead quality, pipeline progression, conversion, and revenue growth

job_description:
**ABOUT REVANTAGE**

Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services.

With a corporate purpose of ‘In Pursuit of Better,’ Revantage delivers value-added services and world-class talent for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, spanning diverse asset classes, including residential, logistics, office, hospitality and retail sectors. The company’s footprint extends across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific.

Creating a culture that inspires impact and momentum requires the right team. We know what it takes to lead an industry, and are looking for leaders who seek constant growth, want to excel, and continuously improve upon themselves and the industry.

In addition to supporting Revantage, we also recruit for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, giving you the unique opportunity to work within a network of best-in-class professionals across a broad real estate platform.

**India**

With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality.

Whether you’re building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you’ll have the opportunity to truly **Build What Matters.**

**ROLE SUMMARY**

We are seeking a Senior Director – Financial Systems for American Campus Communities (ACC), a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This role is based in Bengaluru, India and is hired through Revantage India.

The Senior Director – Financial Systems serves as Finance’s product owner for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Oracle Cloud EPM, with responsibility for translating Finance and Accounting priorities into scalable system capabilities, standardized processes and well-controlled solutions. The role partners closely with Finance, Accounting, FP&A and IT to establish the platform roadmap, govern functional design and investment priorities, and strengthen the systems and processes supporting close, planning, reporting and decision support.

**Primary Role – Oracle Fusion ERP and Oracle EPM Product Ownership**

  

* Own the functional product vision, roadmap and prioritized backlog for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Oracle Cloud EPM, aligning investments to Finance strategy and measurable business outcomes.
* Lead Finance’s role in implementation and enhancement programs from business case and process design through requirements, testing, cutover, stabilization and benefits realization.
* Serve as the senior Finance functional leader for Oracle Fusion Financials, including General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Expenses, Intercompany, Tax, Subledger Accounting and financial reporting, and guide connected Procurement and Project Management scope as applicable.
* Lead product ownership for Oracle EPM across planning, consolidation, close, account reconciliation, enterprise data management and management reporting, enabling an integrated and scalable plan-to-report process.
* Establish governance for demand intake, prioritization, change control, release planning and executive decisions; communicate trade-offs, risks and realized value to senior stakeholders.
* Partner with IT to define Finance requirements for integrations and data flows across Fusion ERP, EPM and adjacent applications, establish reconciliation and control standards, and ensure timely resolution and escalation of material issues.
* Establish and maintain master data governance across ERP and EPM, including clear ownership, standards, stewardship and approval processes in partnership with key business stakeholders.
* Maintain a strong financial systems control environment, including role-based access, segregation of duties, workflow approvals, change management, audit evidence and SOX compliance.
* Lead Finance readiness and user adoption for Oracle quarterly releases and other platform changes, including impact assessment, testing, process documentation, training, communication and change management.
* Lead and develop the Financial Systems team, establishing clear performance expectations, building functional and technical capability, and ensuring appropriate capacity to support implementation and ongoing platform ownership.
* Manage Finance’s relationship with key implementation partners, consultants and technology vendors, ensuring alignment with functional priorities, delivery expectations and business outcomes.
* Drive continuous improvement across Finance processes and systems, identifying opportunities to standardize workflows, reduce manual effort, strengthen controls and improve reporting and decision support.
* undefined

* **QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**
  + Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, information systems, business administration or a related field is required; MBA, CPA, CA or other relevant advanced credential is preferred.
  + 12+ years of progressive financial systems, finance transformation, ERP/EPM product management or related consulting and industry experience.
  + At least five years of leadership experience managing teams and large cross-functional business transformation initiatives.
  + Deep functional experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP Financials and Oracle Cloud EPM, including core financial close, planning, consolidation, reconciliation and reporting processes.
  + Demonstrated leadership of at least one full-cycle Oracle Fusion ERP and/or Oracle EPM implementation, major transformation or global rollout through post-production stabilization.
  + Experience with fit-to-standard design, functional configuration, data conversion, integration coordination, testing, deployment, release management and change adoption.
  + Strong understanding of internal controls, segregation of duties, SOX or comparable control environments, and audit requirements for cloud financial applications.
  + Demonstrated ability to translate finance process requirements into system design and challenge unnecessary customization.
  + Ability to balance strategic product leadership with disciplined execution, resolve complex cross-functional issues and make sound, timely decisions.
  + Exceptional stakeholder management, communication and executive presentation skills; real estate, asset-intensive, multi-entity or highly regulated industry experience is preferred.
  + Work from the Bengaluru office under the hybrid working model, with working hours aligned to provide meaningful daily overlap with US business hours; flexibility is expected during system implementations, quarter-end and year-end close, major releases and other peak periods.
  + Partner with US-based leadership and Revantage India on staffing, hiring, performance management and organizational development to ensure the Financial Systems team has the appropriate capacity and capabilities to support the business.
  + Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned.

*Job Applicant Privacy Notice*

***EEO Statement***

*The Company is an equal opportunity employer. In accordance with applicable law, we prohibit discrimination against any applicant, employee, or other covered person based on any legally recognized basis, including, but not limited to: veteran status, uniformed servicemember status, race, color, caste, immigration status, religion, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), sex, gender, gender expression, gender identity, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation or related medical conditions), age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), protected leave status, domestic violence victim status, or any other consideration protected by federal, state or local law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations, if you need an accommodation to complete the application process, please email* *TalentAcquisitionIndia@revantage.com*
