* Establish governance for demand intake, prioritization, change control, release planning and executive decisions; communicate trade-offs, risks and realized value to senior stakeholders.

job_description:
**Job Description**

It’s not just about your career or job title… It’s about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it’s for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you’re in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us.

**Who are we?**

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.  
  
Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!

*Summary:*

The Staff Technical Product Manager supports the structured execution, adoption, and expansion of Data, Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence initiatives. The role works across product, business, engineering, infrastructure, and operational stakeholders to translate agreed product direction into organized backlogs, coordinated delivery routines, documented decisions, transparent progress, user feedback, effective communications, and transition readiness.

The position helps teams scale capabilities already built by improving reuse, documentation, communication, adoption, and expansion readiness. It also supports new initiatives by coordinating discovery activities, workshops, stakeholder inputs, feedback, dependencies, and follow-through.

To be successful in this role, you should have a strong background in Data & AI strategy definition and implementation, coupled with excellent leadership and communication skills. Experience in people management and a deep understanding of the business and technology landscape are also highly desirable.

If you are a strategic thinker, a passionate advocate for Data & AI innovation, and a collaborative leader, this Director of AI Strategy role presents an exciting opportunity to drive the organization's digital transformation and shape the future of its AI capabilities.

*Duties and Responsibilities:*

1. Operate a consistent product and delivery cadence across assigned initiatives, including backlog reviews, Sprint planning, daily or regular Scrum meetings, demonstrations, retrospectives, project reviews, and dependency discussions.

2. Maintain product and initiative backlogs in coordination with portfolio leadership, Product Owners, Engineering Managers, and technical leads, ensuring that items are clear, traceable, prioritized through the agreed process, and ready for execution.

3. Coordinating with Engineering Managers and technical leads to track delivery progress against agreed backlog items, milestones, acceptance criteria, risks, dependencies, and documented decisions.

4. Ensure progress visibility for infrastructure, platform, data, security, and other enabling initiatives by aggregating updates from responsible owners and highlighting significant dependencies or risks

5. Organize and facilitate discovery, product, business, and engineering workshops after the product vision and strategic direction have been established; prepare objectives and pre-work, coordinate participants, capture decisions, and track actions.

6. Plan user demonstrations, feedback sessions, testing discussions, and adoption reviews; document feedback, structure themes, route inputs to the appropriate owners, and track agreed responses.

7. Help scale capabilities already delivered by coordinating reusable documentation, playbooks, templates, user guidance, communication materials, knowledge transfer, adoption actions, and expansion readiness.

8. Prepare presentations, portfolio updates, meeting packs, agendas, pre-reads, decision logs, status summaries, and stakeholder communications based on agreed product and portfolio direction.

9. Keep product and initiative documentation accurate and up to date, covering requirements, assumptions, acceptance criteria, decisions, open questions, ownership, dependencies, lessons learned, handover details, and evidence of benefits.

10. Coordinate transition and operational readiness, ensuring that documentation, support ownership, user readiness, training inputs, communication, and post-implementation follow-up are planned and tracked.

*Minimum Qualifications:* (To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.)

* University degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience required.
* This position requires a minimum of 7 -10 years’ experience, with hands on experience in the Data & AI Product Management and project management area

*Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:*

* A good understanding of various Data platforms, Cloud or on-prem (Datalake, DWH, Datamarts, Document management, Data interoperability (ETL, API mgt)
* Abilities to define a data & AI platform as a service for enabling other IT teams to benefit from it.

* 7-10 years of overall professional experience in product management, technology program management, digital delivery, data and analytics, business transformation, product operations, or a related field.
* At least 2-3 years of experience in a comparable Product Manager, Product Operations, Agile Program, or technology delivery coordination role.
* Experience running Agile or Scrum ceremonies and maintaining backlogs across one or more business and technology initiatives.
* Experience coordinating Engineering Managers, technical leads, developers, business stakeholders, infrastructure teams, and users in a matrixed environment.
* Experience tracking progress, risks, dependencies, milestones, decisions, and actions across concurrent initiatives.
* Experience facilitating workshops, demonstrations, feedback sessions, planning discussions, and cross-functional working meetings.
* Experience preparing clear presentations, status reports, pre-reads, decision materials, process documentation, and user-facing communications.
* Experience supporting adoption, transition, knowledge transfer, reuse, standardization, or expansion of technology-enabled capabilities.
* Working knowledge of Data, Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, digital products, cloud or infrastructure initiatives, and responsible technology delivery practices.
* Demonstrated ability to influence follow-through without direct authority while respecting product, portfolio, and engineering accountabilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing business priorities.

*Physical Demands and Work Environment:*

* This position is one that would normally require the person to work in a temperature-controlled office environment with other professional and management employees and continent workers, with frequent exposure to electronic office equipment.
* This position will require the employee to maintain hours during a typical day to overlap with team members and business users around the world with special attention to people in the time zones of India, Paris, and the Eastern U.S.
* This position will likely require the employee to travel a few times annually to physically meet with managers or team members.

*About You*

* You bring structure and momentum to complex initiatives without adding unnecessary process.
* You are confident facilitating Scrum ceremonies and product discussions with Engineering Managers, technical leads, senior developers, business stakeholders, and users.
* You can convert product direction and workshop discussions into clear backlog items, decisions, requirements, actions, and communication materials.
* You are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple timelines, dependencies, risks, decisions, and stakeholder commitments.
* You communicate clearly in writing and verbally and can prepare concise, leadership-ready presentations and pre-read materials.
* You listen carefully to users, separate observations from requirements, document feedback objectively, and support evidence-based prioritization.
* You can challenge missing information, unclear ownership, delayed actions, or unmanaged dependencies constructively and respectfully.
* You understand the difference between tracking engineering progress and managing technical quality or individual developer performance.
* You are motivated by scalable outcomes and help teams reuse, document, communicate, adopt, and expand capabilities already built.
* You are a collaborative self-starter who works within agreed portfolio strategy and product vision while taking ownership of execution discipline and follow-through.

**Our Commitment to Embrace Diversity:**

Wabtec is a global company that invests not just in our products, but also our people by embracing diversity and inclusion. We care about our relationships with our employees and take pride in celebrating the variety of experiences, expertise, and backgrounds that bring us together. At Wabtec, we aspire to create a place where we all belong and where diversity is welcomed and appreciated.

To fulfill that commitment, we rely on a culture of leadership, diversity, and inclusion. We aim to employ the world’s brightest minds to help us create a limitless source of ideas and opportunities. We have created a space where everyone is given the opportunity to contribute based on their individual experiences and perspectives and recognize that these differences and diverse perspectives make us better.

We believe in hiring talented people of varied backgrounds, experiences, and styles… People like you! Wabtec Corporation is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or protected Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

 **Additional Information**

**What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?**

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

**Who are we?**

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

**Culture powers us and the possibilities.**

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.

We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.

Need accommodation? Just let us know - we’ve got you.

job_description:
We are seeking a senior sustainability professional with 15+ years of commercial-building domain experience to lead customer sustainability transformation through smart building technologies, digital platforms and Agentic AI-enabled operating models. The role acts as a trusted advisor to customers and executive stakeholders, translating energy, carbon, ESG and autonomous optimization concepts into measurable business outcomes, including energy efficiency, decarbonization, operational excellence and net-zero progress.

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Sustainability, Energy Management, Environmental Engineering or a related discipline; master's degree preferred.

* 15+ years of experience in sustainability consulting, energy management, commercial building operations, building automation, smart buildings, facility management or related industries.

* Deep knowledge of Building Management Systems (BMS), Energy Management Systems (EMS), building automation, IoT architectures and operational technology environments.

* Practical experience in sustainability assessments, energy audits, carbon accounting, building-performance optimization and decarbonization programs.

* Familiarity with LEED, WELL, GRESB, ISO 50001 and related ESG, energy and sustainability frameworks.

* Experience with AI/ML, Generative AI, Agentic AI frameworks, Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, OpenAI or comparable AI orchestration platforms.

* Experience developing business cases and roadmaps for AI-enabled sustainability, smart-building transformation or digital operations programs.

* Demonstrated success driving innovation through emerging technologies, analytics, data-driven decisions and scalable operating models.

SUCCESS MEASURES: FIRST 12–18 MONTHS

* Influence multiple strategic customer sustainability programs and establish a qualified pipeline of Agentic AI-enabled building optimization opportunities.

* Deliver measurable outcomes in energy reduction, carbon footprint reduction, asset uptime, faster issue detection/resolution, reduced manual effort and occupant experience.

* Create repeatable AI-enabled sustainability frameworks that can scale across customer portfolios and become a trusted advisor for ESG, energy and digital transformation initiatives.

* Demonstrate business value from autonomous decision-making, predictive optimization and intelligent building operations.

  

Sustainability Strategy & Advisory

* Lead sustainability assessments and strategic roadmaps for commercial buildings, real estate portfolios, campuses and critical infrastructure.

* Advise customers on decarbonization pathways, energy optimization, net-zero programs, ESG reporting and sustainability best practices.

* Identify opportunities to improve building performance, occupant experience, operational resilience and environmental impact.

* Provide solution consulting across discovery, assessment, solution definition, implementation support and value realization.

Agentic AI for Intelligent Building Operations

* Define and scale Agentic AI applications that autonomously monitor, analyze, recommend and optimize commercial-building operations.

* Develop use cases across energy optimization, carbon reduction, predictive maintenance, fault detection, space utilization, comfort control and ESG performance monitoring.

* Collaborate with product, engineering and data-science teams to design agent workflows, multi-agent orchestration patterns, guardrails and human-in-the-loop operating models.

* Translate customer sustainability challenges into AI-enabled solution architectures using digital twins, IoT data, BMS/EMS integration, OT systems, analytics and autonomous decision workflows.

Customer Engagement & Value Communication

* Engage C-level executives, sustainability leaders, facility managers, operations teams and engineering stakeholders as a trusted advisor.

* Develop compelling business cases covering ROI, energy savings, carbon abatement, productivity gains, asset uptime and reduced manual operational effort.

* Facilitate workshops, executive briefings and strategy sessions that align sustainability ambition with practical implementation roadmaps.

* Present recommendations, deployment plans and realized outcomes clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Solution Development, Delivery & Measurement

* Partner with sales, product management, engineering, consulting and services teams to create customer-centric sustainability and AI solutions.

* Support solution architecture and implementation planning to ensure proposed capabilities deliver measurable environmental, operational and financial outcomes.

* Define KPIs, baselines and measurement frameworks for energy intensity, carbon emissions, comfort, uptime, issue resolution and adoption.

* Establish repeatable playbooks and frameworks for AI-driven sustainability consulting and autonomous building optimization.

Innovation & Thought Leadership

* Track emerging sustainability regulations, market needs, smart-building technologies, AI/ML innovation, GenAI, Agentic AI frameworks and digital transformation trends.

* Contribute to new offerings, solution accelerators, service models and scalable frameworks for intelligent building operations.

* Represent the organization in industry forums, customer events, executive briefings and sustainability-focused engagements.

* Mentor teams and foster a culture of innovation, customer centricity, responsible AI adoption and continuous improvement.

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Technical Product Manager - Principal
job_description:
**Senior Product Manager / Solutions Architect – Design Automation & AI Workflows**
===================================================================================

**Company Overview**  
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

**Want to Help Shape How Chips Are Designed in the Future?**

* How would you automate workflows that have traditionally required years of engineering expertise?
* How would you combine AI, optimization, and domain knowledge to solve challenging problems across analog, custom digital, and standard cell design?
* How would you help customers migrate decades of intellectual property between design environments?
* How would you create products that make engineers dramatically more productive while improving design quality?
* How would you take breakthrough ideas from concept to deployment at the world's leading semiconductor companies?

That's what we do. We're looking for people who are excited about solving difficult problems and making a meaningful impact. You'll work at the intersection of semiconductor design, AI, product strategy, and customer engagement. The ideal candidate understands complex design challenges, can translate customer needs into product requirements, and enjoys helping bring innovative technologies from concept to production.

**Responsibilities**

* Define product requirements and workflows for next-generation design automation solutions.
* Work directly with customers to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and validate proposed solutions.
* Drive product direction for technologies across analog design, standard cell design, custom digital implementation, design migration, and design automation.
* Partner closely with engineering teams to translate customer needs into product capabilities and deliverables.
* Define use cases, success metrics, benchmarks, and customer adoption strategies.
* Lead evaluations, demonstrations, customer engagements, and early-access deployments.
* Influence roadmap priorities based on market needs, customer feedback, and competitive analysis.

**Requirements**

* BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience in semiconductor design, EDA, or related technical fields.
* Experience defining solutions, workflows, or products that have been successfully delivered to users or customers.
* Experience applying automation, AI, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic AI technologies to engineering workflows.
* Strong understanding of one or more of the following domains:
  + Analog and custom IC design
  + Standard cell design and optimization
  + Physical implementation
  + Design migration and design reuse
  + Semiconductor design automation
  + Physical verification, extraction, and simulation workflows
* Experience working directly with customers to gather requirements and drive technology adoption.
* Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively across product management, engineering, sales, and customer teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Analog and custom IC design workflows.
* Circuit simulation, SPICE, and analog verification flows.
* DRC, LVS, parasitic extraction, and physical verification.
* OpenAccess-based design environments.
* Experience with commercial EDA platforms such as Cadence Virtuoso.
* Delivering software products used in production semiconductor design flows.
* Technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration.

We are looking for product leaders who are excited by emerging technology, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to help shape the future of semiconductor design. Success in this role requires a combination of technical depth, customer focus, business judgment, and the ability to turn innovative ideas into widely adopted solutions.

**Why us?**  
Working at Siemens Software means flexibility — choosing between working at home and the office (with state-of-the-art facilities in Bangalore and Noida) at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate , serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.

**Team's Impact**

The Analytics API & MCP Platform team is responsible for delivering FactSet's analytics capabilities through scalable APIs, developer platforms, and AI-enabled solutions. The team enables clients, partners, and internal applications to access portfolio analytics, performance attribution, risk, and investment insights through modern integration channels including APIs, Power BI, Snowflake, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) applications.

Our mission is to create seamless, secure, and scalable experiences that help clients integrate FactSet analytics into their workflows, applications, and AI-powered solutions.

**Role Overview**

The Associate Product Manager partners with clients, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, solve customer problems, and deliver impactful product outcomes. This role supports the full product lifecycle, including discovery, requirements definition, execution, launch, adoption, and ongoing product optimization.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical skills with a product mindset and is passionate about APIs, developer experiences, data integration platforms, and AI-enabled workflows.

**What You'll Do**

**Customer & Product Discovery**

* Gather and analyse feedback from clients, prospects, and internal stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, and product opportunities.

* Participate in product discovery activities, market research, and validation of new product concepts.

* Help define success metrics and measure product outcomes.

**Product Development & Execution**

* Define and document business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

* Collaborate closely with Engineering, UX, and stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle.

* Support prioritization of enhancements, client requests, defects, and technical improvements.

* Participate in testing, release validation, and post-release monitoring to ensure product quality.

**Analytics API & MCP Platform Ownership**

* Develop deep expertise in Analytics APIs, MCP solutions, developer workflows, and platform capabilities.

* Support client onboarding, implementation, and adoption of Analytics API and MCP solutions.

* Troubleshoot product, integration, entitlement, authentication, and configuration issues.

* Act as a subject matter expert for internal stakeholders and client-facing teams.

**Adoption, Monitoring & Enablement**

* Monitor usage, client adoption, and key product health metrics.

* Help improve product instrumentation, analytics, and reporting capabilities.

* Create and maintain product documentation, knowledge base content, release communications, and onboarding materials.

* Support internal training and client enablement initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Product, Engineering, Consulting, Sales, Support, and Client Success teams to deliver successful outcomes.

* Contribute ideas that improve processes, product quality, scalability, and client experience.

Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and a continuous learning mindset.  



**What We're Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.

* 2-5 years of experience in Product Development, Product Management, Business Analysis, Financial Technology, or a related role.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

* Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Experience working in Agile software development environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA and working knowledge on Python preffered

* Understanding of REST APIs, API lifecycle management, authentication, and developer workflows.

* Experience with API testing and troubleshooting tools (e.g., Postman).

* Familiarity with JSON, OpenAPI specifications, and technical documentation.

* Experience supporting integrations with **Power BI** , **Snowflake** , or similar analytics and data platforms.

* Exposure to AI, LLMs, MCP, copilots, or agent-based applications.

Knowledge of portfolio analytics, performance attribution, risk analytics, or investment workflows.  



**Key Competencies**

**Insights**

* Uses data, client feedback, and market research to identify product opportunities and drive decisions.

**Strategy**

* Understands how Analytics APIs, Snowflake, Power BI, and MCP capabilities support FactSet's broader platform strategy.

**Execution**

* Delivers high-quality product outcomes through strong requirements, prioritization, testing, and stakeholder collaboration.

**Technical Expertise**

* Develops expertise in APIs, data integration platforms, developer tooling, and AI-enabled workflows.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Influences through communication, data, and relationship building while effectively collaborating across cross-functional teams.

**Career Progression**

**Product Specialist Senior Product Specialist Associate Product Manager Product Manager Senior Product Manager**

  

**What's In It For You**

At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.
  

Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.

**Company Overview:**

FactSet ( NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS ) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn .

At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

* Familiarity with JSON, OpenAPI specifications, and technical documentation.

* Experience supporting integrations with **Power BI** , **Snowflake** , or similar analytics and data platforms.

* Exposure to AI, LLMs, MCP, copilots, or agent-based applications.

Knowledge of portfolio analytics, performance attribution, risk analytics, or investment workflows.  



**Key Competencies**

**Insights**

* Uses data, client feedback, and market research to identify product opportunities and drive decisions.

**Strategy**

* Understands how Analytics APIs, Snowflake, Power BI, and MCP capabilities support FactSet's broader platform strategy.

**Execution**

* Delivers high-quality product outcomes through strong requirements, prioritization, testing, and stakeholder collaboration.

**Technical Expertise**

* Develops expertise in APIs, data integration platforms, developer tooling, and AI-enabled workflows.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Influences through communication, data, and relationship building while effectively collaborating across cross-functional teams.

**Career Progression**

**Product Specialist Senior Product Specialist Associate Product Manager Product Manager Senior Product Manager**

  

**What's In It For You**

At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.
  

Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.

**Company Overview:**

FactSet ( NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS ) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn .

At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

title: Product Lead
job_description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

**Product Lead – Skills**

1. Strong domain and business knowledge in relevant product, operations, and technology areas.

2. Experience working with agile product delivery teams across multiple squads.

3. Strong knowledge of backlog management, prioritization, release planning, and dependency management.

4. Ability to assess business value, urgency, risks, capacity constraints, and delivery trade-offs.

5. Experience using Jira, ESM, dashboards, and reporting tools for backlog and delivery visibility.

6. Strong stakeholder management skills across Product, Engineering, Delivery, Operations, SMEs, and business teams.

7. Ability to translate product strategy and business needs into actionable priorities for squads.

8. Strong communication, influencing, and problem-solving skills.

9. Experience coaching or mentoring Product Owners, Business Analysts, or similar roles.

10. Understanding of functional requirements, non-functional requirements, technical debt, production support, and continuous improvement.

11. Ability to work effectively in a complex environment with high request volumes and competing priorities.

12. Understanding of agile principles, product operating models, and governance practices.

**Product Lead – Roles & Responsibilities**

1. Act as the domain-level product lead for a defined area, such as Core, Print, or Voting/Tabulation/Edit Load.

2. Translate Product Manager strategy, roadmap priorities, and business objectives into clear direction for Product Owners and squads.

3. Support prioritization and sequencing of work across squads, including discretionary initiatives, run/OCC work, lite requests, regulatory work, production support, and technical debt.

4. Review incoming requests for business value, urgency, timelines, dependencies, impacted squads, capacity implications, and governance needs.

5. Ensure requests are categorized and prioritized using agreed criteria, such as Critical, High, Medium, and Low.

6. Work with Product Owners to align squad backlogs with domain priorities, roadmap commitments, and available capacity.

7. Guide Product Owners on backlog quality, requirement readiness, prioritization, stakeholder communication, and dependency management.

8. Participate in key business and refinement discussions for complex, high-priority, cross-squad, or high-risk initiatives.

9. Ensure appropriate SME involvement for discovery, technical clarification, spikes, and requirement validation.

10.Coordinate with Delivery Managers, Engineering leaders, QA leads, SMEs, and Scrum Masters on delivery constraints, dependencies, and sequencing impacts.

11. Maintain visibility into domain-level capacity, delivery risks, blockers, resource constraints, and impacts to roadmap commitments.

12. Identify and escalate priority conflicts, major trade-offs, cross-squad dependencies, and delivery risks to the Product Manager when needed.

13. Support domain intake reviews, backlog reviews, prioritization discussions, and governance preparation.

14. Provide regular domain-level updates on priorities, progress, risks, capacity, dependencies, and milestone impacts.

15. Coach and support Product Owners; where needed, directly perform Product Owner responsibilities for specific initiatives, including gathering requirements, creating/refining stories, managing backlog items, and supporting delivery through completion.

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

**Use of AI in Hiring**

As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

Experience: 3 to 6 Years Job Requisition: TBD  
About the Role  
We’re seeking a Business Analyst / Product Owner with strong expertise in U.S. tax reporting and securities processing. You’ll act as the bridge between business stakeholders and engineering teams, ensuring our products meet complex IRS requirements while driving operational efficiency for global clients. This role combines product ownership, business analysis, and Agile/Scrum leadership to deliver impactful financial solutions.  
Key Responsibilities  

Product Ownership  
Define and prioritize product backlog items with a focus on IRS/regulatory compliance (cost basis, income reclassification, tax form production).  
Act as Product Owner in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, ensuring clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and alignment with business goals.  

Agile & Scrum Delivery  
Collaborate with Scrum Masters and development teams to drive sprint planning, backlog refinement, and timely delivery.  
Champion Agile practices, fostering transparency, adaptability, and continuous improvement across teams.  

Cross-Functional Collaboration  
Partner with Development, QA teams across geographies to deliver scalable, compliant solutions.  
Facilitate workshops, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to align stakeholders and ensure shared understanding of product goals.  

Client Engagement  
Work directly with clients and partners to capture reporting needs, regulatory changes, and operational challenges.  
Translate complex tax and securities requirements into actionable user stories and product features.  

Domain Expertise  
Apply deep knowledge of IRS/regulatory practices, withholding, corporate actions, and back-office operations.  
Ensure solutions meet tax reporting/regulatory standards with accuracy, reliability, and audit readiness.  
Qualifications  

Hands-on industry experience in U.S. Tax Reporting and Securities Processing.  

Strong knowledge of IRS requirements for cost basis, income, withholding, and form production.  

Experience with back-office platforms (BPS, BETA preferred).  

Demonstrated success working in Agile/Scrum environments as a Product Owner or Business Analyst.  

Technical expertise in SQL, PostgreSQL, and Power BI for advanced data analysis, reporting, and visualization.  

Strong communication abilities, adept at engaging with clients and stakeholders.
